title: Senior Manager-People & Culture
description:
What we want to accomplish and why we need you?
   

  

 Jio Haptik is an AI leader having pioneered AI\-powered innovation since 2013\. Reliance Jio Digital Services acquired Haptik in April 2019\. Haptik currently leads India’s AI market having become the first to process 15 billion\+ two\-way conversations across 10\+ channels and in 135 languages. Haptik is also a Category Leader across platforms including Gartner, G2, Opus Research \& more. Recently Haptik won the award for “Tech Startup of the Year” in the AI category at Entrepreneur India Awards 2023, and gold medal for “Best Chat \& Conversational Bot” at Martequity Awards 2023\. Haptik has a headcount of 200\+ employees with offices in Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore.
   

  

 With a team of 200\+ Haptikans spread across Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore, we are now at an exciting inflection point of growth — one that calls for an evolved People \& Culture strategy. We are looking for a
 **Senior** 
 Manager – People \& Culture who will be a strategic partner to our business and leadership teams, driving an exceptional employee experience, culture transformation, and operational excellence.
   

  

 This role is for someone who believes great cultures don’t just happen — they are intentionally built, nurtured, and sustained.
   

  

 What will you do every day?
   

  

* Partner with business and functional leaders to align people strategies with organizational goals, ensuring HR plays a pivotal role in driving business success.
* Lead and execute the performance management cycle, from goal setting and calibration to feedback and development.
* Drive employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives that foster inclusion, collaboration, and recognition across the organization.
* Champion learning and development initiatives, identifying skill gaps and supporting the creation of programs that empower Haptikans to grow.
* Oversee HR operations, ensuring smooth execution of onboarding, exits, HRIS, compliance, and data management.
* Continuously review and enhance policies and processes to ensure fairness, consistency, and scalability.
* Drive people analytics and insights to inform decisions on engagement, retention, and workforce health.
* Act as a culture custodian, ensuring our values are lived through every touchpoint of the employee journey.


 Ok, you're sold, but what are we looking for in the perfect candidate?
   

  

* You bring 7 \- 10 years of experience in Human Resources, with strong exposure to HR Business Partnering and HR Operations in fast\-paced, evolving organizations.
* You’ve successfully led initiatives in performance management, talent development, engagement, and organizational design.
* You thrive on building relationships — your stakeholders trust your judgment, and your teams value your empathy and fairness.
* You have experience managing end\-to\-end HR operations, with a strong eye for process improvement and compliance.
* You are data\-driven, using insights to influence leadership decisions and measure impact.
* You bring a growth mindset and a genuine passion for creating a culture where people feel inspired, valued, and empowered.
* Experience in technology or high\-growth digital organizations will be a strong plus.

title: React.js Frontend Developer
description:
**About Company**
**Papigen** 
 is a fast\-growing global technology services company, delivering innovative digital solutions through deep industry experience and cutting\-edge expertise. We specialize in technology transformation, enterprise modernization, and dynamic areas like Cloud, Big Data, Java, React, DevOps, and more. Our client\-centric approach combines consulting, engineering, and data science to help businesses evolve and scale efficiently.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced
 **React.js Frontend Developer** 
 to support an enterprise modernization initiative. The role involves building
 **modern, responsive, and cloud\-integrated UI applications** 
 using React.js and related technologies. The work will focus on UI modernization, reusable component architecture, performance tuning, and integration with backend services and Microsoft platforms. You will work closely with the engineering team, Technical Leads, and MS Power Platform developers to deliver scalable, accessible, and maintainable frontend solutions.
   

  

 Scope of Work
   

  

**The Selected Developer Will Work On Initiatives Across**
* User Interface Modernization – building clean, intuitive, responsive UIs optimized for performance and accessibility (a11y, WCAG).
* Reusable UI Components – developing design systems, shared UI libraries and Storybook\-driven component catalogs.
* Frontend Integrations – connecting React applications with REST APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and backend microservices.
* Cloud \& Microsoft Platform Deployment – optimizing and deploying applications within cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP) and integrating with MS Power Platform and Azure services.


**Essential Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain advanced frontend applications using React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3\. Apply modern practices such as functional components, hooks, and component\-driven development.
* Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into responsive, accessible, and pixel\-perfect interfaces.
* Build reusable component libraries, design systems, and documentation (Storybook, component docs).
* Work with MS Power Platform team to host and integrate React applications within the Microsoft ecosystem, ensuring reliable authentication and secure API integrations.
* Implement state management using Redux (Redux Toolkit), Recoil, MobX, Zustand, or Context API where appropriate. Apply best practices for predictable state, side\-effect handling (Redux Saga/Thunk), and immutability.
* Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and backend microservices. Implement robust error handling, retries and caching strategies.
* Conduct code reviews, write unit and integration tests (Jest, React Testing Library), and support CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, fast load times (code splitting, lazy loading, tree shaking), and cross\-browser compatibility. Use tools like Lighthouse and bundle analyzers for measurement.
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives, and mentor junior engineers on frontend best practices.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of frontend development experience with a strong focus on React.js (React 16/17/18\) and production\-scale UI applications.
* Deep proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript, including modern syntax, typings, and best practices.
* Strong expertise in React Hooks, Context API, Suspense, component patterns, render optimization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience with state management libraries: Redux (Redux Toolkit), Recoil, MobX, Zustand, or similar patterns for predictable state handling.
* Familiarity with UI frameworks and styling approaches: Material\-UI (MUI), Ant Design, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Chakra UI, Styled Components, Emotion.
* Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD workflows, and test frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library, as well as E2E testing tools such as Cypress or Playwright.
* Experience with performance tuning, lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, and optimization techniques (Lighthouse, bundle analysis).
* Proficiency with build tools and bundlers: Webpack, Vite, Parcel, esbuild, and package managers (npm/yarn/pnpm).
* Solid understanding of authentication flows (OAuth/OIDC, JWT), web security best practices (CSP, XSS/CSRF mitigation), and secure frontend coding.
* Excellent debugging, observability and problem\-solving capabilities; familiarity with monitoring and error tracking tools (Sentry, New Relic) is a plus.


 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience integrating React apps with Microsoft Power Platform and embedding solutions within Power Apps or Power Pages.
* Exposure to backend concepts or full\-stack development (Node.js, Express, GraphQL, microservices) and familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, GitHub Actions, cloud deployments (Azure/AWS/GCP), and containerization (Docker).
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM/ALM tools, and experience working in large enterprise environments.


 Keywords \& Skill Tags
   

  

 React, React.js, Frontend Developer, Front\-end Engineer, UI Developer, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES6, Redux, Redux Toolkit, Recoil, MobX, Zustand, Hooks, Next.js, SSR, CSR, Node.js, REST API, GraphQL, Microservices, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Material\-UI, Ant Design, Chakra UI, Styled Components, Emotion, Webpack, Vite, Parcel, esbuild, npm, yarn, pnpm, Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Azure, AWS, GCP, Power Platform, Accessibility, a11y, WCAG, Performance Optimization, Code Splitting, Lazy Loading, Storybook, Design Systems, Observability, Sentry.
   

  

 Education

* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on professional experience in frontend development; candidates with 8\+ years of experience (senior/lead) are encouraged to apply.

description:
**Facilities Operations****Job Description**


**The Weaver Experience**



Weaver is a full\-service national accounting, advisory and consulting firm with opportunities for professionals in many different fields. We seek to bring a human element to the world of accounting, which includes creating a diverse, collaborative, and entrepreneurial workplace culture. Our leaders truly care about the well\-being of all our employees and encourage them to pursue their ambitions.



While our business is based in numbers, our success is truly based on people. It’s why we commit to supporting our people not just in their professional growth, but also in their ability to lead balanced, integrated lives. At the foundation of that commitment are our core values. Weaver’s core values were created specifically to empower our people to deliver extraordinary service and be their best selves. Our goal is to balance high development with high performance in order to meet the long\-term goals of each individual, team, and our firm.



Learn more about our services, industry experience and culture at weaver.com.


**Position Profile**



Weaver India, LLP is looking for a Senior Manager to oversee the Administration, Travel and Facility Operations in India. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility operations, maintenance, safety, and infrastructure management across the organization. The Senior Manager will ensure that all physical environments support business objectives, comply with regulatory requirements, and maintain high standards of efficiency, safety, and sustainability. The role also includes leading the facilities team, managing vendors, and driving strategic initiatives related to workspace planning, asset management, and operational excellence.


**Responsibilities**


**1\. Facilities Operations \& Management**


* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of all office and facility locations.
* Ensure all facilities are well\-maintained, functional, and compliant with safety, legal, and regulatory standards.
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and other systems.


**2\. Leadership \& Team Management**


* Lead, mentor, and develop the facilities management team.
* Allocate resources, manage workloads, and ensure the team meets performance and operational expectations.


**3\. Vendor \& Contract Management**


* Manage external vendors for maintenance, security, housekeeping, landscaping, and other facility\-related services.
* Negotiate contracts, track performance, and ensure value delivery and service\-level compliance.


**4\. Space Planning \& Workplace Strategy**


* Oversee space planning, seating layouts, and office expansion or relocation projects.
* Work closely with HR and business leaders to forecast space requirements.
* Ensure workspace design supports employee productivity and organizational culture.


**5\. Budgeting \& Cost Control**


* Prepare and manage the facilities budget, including capital expenditure and operating costs.
* Identify cost\-saving initiatives without compromising safety or quality.


**6\. Health, Safety \& Compliance**


* Ensure compliance with fire safety, environmental regulations, and occupational health standards.
* Oversee emergency response plans, safety audits, and risk assessments.


**7\. Sustainability \& Energy Management**


* Drive sustainability initiatives such as energy efficiency, waste reduction, and green building practices.
* Monitor utility consumption and identify opportunities for reduction.


**8**. **Travel Management**

* Oversee and coordinate employee travel arrangements, including flight, hotel, and transportation bookings.
* Liaise with travel agencies and negotiate travel\-related contracts.
* Develop and maintain company travel policies and ensure employee compliance.
* Track travel expenses and prepare periodic travel reports for management.


**9\. Project Management**


* Lead facility\-related projects including renovations, upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.
* Coordinate with architects, contractors, and internal stakeholders for timely project execution.


 **Education and Skills**


* Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10–15 years of experience in facilities management, with at least 5 years in a leadership/managerial role.
* Strong knowledge of building systems, maintenance procedures, safety standards, and compliance regulations.
* Proven experience in vendor management and contract negotiations.
* Excellent budgeting, planning, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.


**People are our formula!**At Weaver, we recognize that everyone brings different strengths, backgrounds, and working styles to our team. We cultivate a safe and inclusive work environment that celebrates each individual’s unique qualities through visibility, progression, advocacy, and support. We are proudly an equal opportunity employer.


**What’s next?** Interested applicants should apply directly to the job posting. You may apply to multiple roles. Be sure to upload your most recent resume and ensure that it is attached to your application. By registering, you are only activating an account and creating a presence. Please apply directly to a position of interest. You will receive a confirmation email after completing an application for a role. After reviewing your application, a friendly Weaver Recruiter will contact you soon and walk you through the hiring process. Thank you for exploring a career with us. We look forward to meeting you!

It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

With category leading brands such as Sensodyne, Voltaren and Centrum, built on trusted science and human understanding, and combined with our passion, knowledge and expertise, we’re uniquely placed to do this and to grow a strong, successful business.  

This is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future. It’s an opportunity to be part of something special.
Key Responsibilities:* Support and lead employees and managers across full employee lifecycle through advisory (“how do I?”) and coaching on HR procedures (process \& policy) covering key topics Hire to Exit across India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.

(Why you?)

We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives.

The HR Head will lead the Human Resources function for Trek India. This role is responsible for developing and executing HR strategies that align with business objectives, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and organizational policies.

* Analyze HR metrics and reports to inform decision\-making and drive continuous improvement in HR processes.
* Lead and mentor the HR team, fostering professional development and enhancing team performance.

**Key Responsibilities (cont.)**

* Manage succession planning efforts to ensure leadership development and continuity.
* Stay informed about HR trends and changes in labor laws to ensure the organization remains compliant.
* Design initiatives to enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion across the organization.
* Manage performance appraisal systems and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Develop competitive compensation structures and benefits programs.

* Manage employee relations and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Oversee payroll, HRIS systems, and accurate employee data management.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources Management or related fields.
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience or senior HR leadership role.
* Relevant certification in HR (e.g., SHRM, HRCI, CIPD).
* Deep understanding of organizational development, employee engagement, and change management.
* Strong knowledge of HR principles, practices, and employment laws in India.
* Familiarity with HR software and systems (e.g., ADP, Workday, performance management tools).
* Understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives and best practices.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a data\-driven approach to HR decision\-making.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred skills and qualifications**

Leverage their business management skills to oversee a company's workforce. Develop organizational strategies to benefit employees and the company.

Develop and monitor budgets for their department. Budget for other HR functions, such as development programs and employee benefits.

Attract, hire and retain top talent for Trek India. Ability to determine how to provide current employees with training or tools to improve productivity.

Give presentations and address employees as a group. Ability to communicate information and instructions to staff members in a manner that's clear and easy to understand.

Strong leadership skills to direct managers and other staff in the HR department. Ability to oversee operations related to hiring, training, professional development, employee experience and the overall workplace culture. Talent Acquisition, Admin, any other HR roles will report into this role.

Manage HR activities and tasks effectively. Ability to have specific processes to ensure they keep confidential information secure and manage all employee data correctly.

People skills, interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with Senior Leadership and other managers and develop strong working relationships.

title: Lead Management Associate
description:
**Closing on:** Dec 31, 2025
### **About Doyensys:**



Doyensys is a Management \& Technology Consulting company with expertise in Enterprise applications, Infrastructure Platform Support, and solutions. Doyensys helps clients to harness the power of innovation to thrive on change. The company leverages its technology expertise, global talent, and extensive industry experience to deliver powerful next\-generation IT services and solutions. Doyensys Inc has operations in India, the US, Mexico, and Canada.
### **Job Requirement**


**Project Role:** Management Trainee (LEAD Hiring)
**Project Role Description:** We are seeking dynamic and enthusiastic fresh graduates to join us as Management Trainees. This role is designed to nurture talent with strong technical fundamentals, problem\-solving capabilities, and a continuous learning mindset. Selected candidates will undergo structured training and gain exposure across databases, application development, AI/ML solutions, and enterprise platforms.
**Work Experience:** Fresher
**Work Location:** Chennai – WFO
**Shift:** General Shift – Monday to Friday
### **Key Responsibilities**


Participate in a structured training program covering application development, database programming, and business intelligence tools.
Learn and contribute to application development using Java, Python, or Full\-Stack technologies.
Assist in developing UI\-based applications using VB, Apex, React, or equivalent frameworks.
Work with SQL and databases to understand data models, queries, and performance basics.
Gain exposure to AI\-driven solutions, including AI Agents and Agentic AI concepts.
Collaborate with mentors and team members to solve real\-world business problems.
Participate in assessments and continuous evaluations throughout the training program.
### **Required Technical Skills**


Basic knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, Python, or Full\-Stack development.
Hands\-on exposure to building UI\-based applications using VB, Apex, React, or similar technologies.
Good understanding of SQL and database fundamentals.
Exposure or strong interest in AI technologies, including AI Agents and Agentic AI.
Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
Excellent communication skills with a strong learning attitude.
### **Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)**


Familiarity with APIs and application integration concepts.
Exposure to integration patterns and handling payload formats such as JSON and XML.
Basic understanding of Oracle platforms and RDBMS concepts.
Participation in technology events, forums, or hackathons.
Demonstrated leadership experience through academic projects or initiatives.
### **What We Offer**


Well\-structured training program covering application development, database programming, and BI tools.
Hands\-on training on Oracle Cloud platforms, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), OTBI, BI Publisher (BIP), and Data Loaders.
Periodic assessments with continued engagement based on overall performance and evaluation scores.
Mentorship from industry experts to strengthen technical and managerial skills.
Opportunities to work on real\-world enterprise applications and AI\-driven solutions.
### **Qualifications \& Eligibility**


B.E / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. (IT) or equivalent qualification.
Fresh graduates with a strong academic background.
Minimum of 80% across the entire academic career.
### **Soft Skills**


Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
High adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.
Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving abilities.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.

title: Travel Support Agent
description:
**Job Title: Travel Support Agent**  
**Location:** Ahmedabad (On\-site, From Office)  
**Type:** Full\-Time

We are hiring enthusiastic individuals for the role of **Travel Support Agent** at our Ahmedabad office. This role is ideal for candidates who want to build a strong career in customer support within the travel domain.

**Role Overview**  
The Travel Process Associate will assist customers through written communication channels such as email, chat, text, and social media. You will handle travel\-related queries, provide accurate information, and deliver exceptional service through professional communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to customer inquiries through non\-verbal written channels
* Help customers with travel\-related concerns and provide accurate solutions
* Maintain service quality and ensure customer satisfaction
* Demonstrate empathy, accuracy, and clarity in communication

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum qualification: High School Diploma or equivalent
* Freshers are welcome; prior customer support experience preferred
* Strong written English communication skills

the success of engagement(s)

* Empathetic leadership and inclusivity \- creating a safe and thriving environment where everyone's valued for who they are, use empathy to understand others to adapt our behaviors and attitudes to become more inclusive.

  


**How you’ll grow**

  


***Connect for impact!***

  



Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.

  


***Empower to lead!***

  



You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterized by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. ***Inclusion for all***

Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.

  


***Drive your career!***

  



At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.

Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
Field Sales Executive – Ajmera Motors (Authorised Ashok Leyland LCV Dealership)

1\. Position Details

* Job Title: Field Sales Executive
* Department: Sales – Light Commercial Vehicles (LCV)
* Company: Ajmera Motors
* Location: Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Raigad, Palghar
* Reporting To: Sales Manager / Director – Ajmera Motors
* Role Type: Full\-Time, Field\-Based
* Work Mode: In\-Person (Field \+ Office Coordination)

2\. Role Purpose

The Field Sales Executive is responsible for generating retail sales of Ashok Leyland Light Commercial Vehicles within the assigned territories.

The role requires daily field activities, identifying business prospects, managing the complete sales cycle, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The executive represents Ajmera Motors in the market and acts as a key contributor to the dealership’s growth and brand image.

3\. Key Responsibilities (SOP Format)

A. Lead Generation \& Market Coverage

Objective:

To continuously source potential buyers and expand business reach in the designated market.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Conduct daily field visits to:

* Industrial estates
* Warehouses
* Transport hubs
* Construction sites
* Business clusters

2\. Minimum 25–30 customer interactions per day (in\-person \+ telephonic).

3\. Generate a minimum of 10 new leads per day.

4\. Capture complete customer details in Lead Tracker/CRM:

* Company name
* Contact details
* Requirement
* Budget
* Follow\-up schedule
* Lead status

5\. Submit daily lead report to the Sales Manager before EOD.

6\. Maintain strong presence in local transport and fleet communities to increase brand visibility.

B. Product Presentation \& Demonstration

Objective:

To educate customers about Ashok Leyland LCVs and build trust.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Study all model specifications, payload capacities, mileage, body options, EMI schemes, and market advantages.

2\. Present product features clearly with comparison against competition.

3\. Conduct on\-site demos or arrange demos at Ajmera Motors.

4\. Ensure safe and professional handling during test drives.

5\. Submit customer feedback weekly to Sales Manager.

C. Sales Cycle Management

Objective:

To execute the sales process systematically and ensure smooth customer onboarding.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Prospecting: Identify requirement, intended use, and budget.

2\. Quotation:

* Issue quotations in Ajmera Motors approved template.
* Ensure accuracy in price, schemes, and discounts.

3\. Finance Support:

* Collect complete KYC, income documents, and profile.
* Coordinate with finance team \& NBFCs for loan login and approval.

4\. Booking:

* Fill booking form completely.
* Collect booking amount.
* Confirm vehicle allocation through Sales Manager.

5\. Pre\-Delivery Coordination:

* Liaise with Accounts for payments.
* Coordinate with Delivery Team for vehicle readiness.
* Assist customer with registration, insurance, and DO.

6\. Delivery Process:

* Ensure proper delivery ceremony.
* Provide vehicle operating guidance.

7\. Post\-Delivery:

* Conduct mandatory follow\-ups: 3 days → 7 days → 30 days.
* Ensure customer is connected with Service department for first free service.

D. Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

Objective:

To ensure long\-term repeat business and build loyalty.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Maintain regular follow\-ups with all leads (hot, warm, cold).

2\. Build relations with:

* Fleet owners
* Transport associations
* Industrial buyers
* Market committees

3\. Provide support in queries related to service, AMC, insurance renewal.

4\. Escalate unresolved issues to Sales Manager immediately.

5\. Maintain a Customer Contact Book for long\-term retention.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

Objective:

To ensure transparent and accurate record keeping.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Submit Daily Activity Report (DAR) by 7:30 PM containing:

* Field visits
* Leads generated
* Follow\-ups
* Hot cases

2\. Maintain weekly sales pipeline covering:

* Expected closures
* Follow\-up status
* Documentation pending

3\. Update CRM daily without fail.

4\. Keep all documents organized:

* Quotations
* Booking forms
* KYC papers
* Finance login documents
* Delivery checklist

5\. Protect confidentiality of customer and dealership data.

F. Market Intelligence

Objective:

To maintain awareness of competitor strategies and market movements.

Standard Procedures:

1\. Collect competitor information weekly such as:

* New model launches
* Temporary schemes or exchange offers
* Price updates

2\. Visit competitor dealerships where necessary.

3\. Share monthly competitor report with the Sales Manager.

4\. Maintain Market Intelligence Register.

4\. Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Minimum HSC (Graduate preferred).
* Experience: 1–5 years in Automobile/LCV Sales (Freshers may also apply).
* Good communication in Hindi \& Marathi.
* Ability to work in field\-based, target\-driven environments.
* Strong local area knowledge of Mumbai, Thane \& Navi Mumbai routes.
* Basic computer proficiency (Excel, Email, WhatsApp).
* Two\-wheeler with valid licence preferred.
* Professional behaviour, discipline, and commitment.

5\. Compensation \& Benefits

* Monthly CTC: ₹20,000 – ₹35,000
* Monthly payout: ₹10,266 – ₹31,950 (approx. depending on structure)
* Performance\-based incentives (bookings \+ deliveries)
* Fuel reimbursement
* Mobile reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Career growth opportunities:

Sales Executive → Sr. Executive → Team Leader → Fleet Sales → Sales Manager

6\. Work Timings \& Discipline

* Working Days: Monday – Saturday
* Timings: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* Flexible field schedule depending on customer appointments
* Mandatory morning reporting (office or video call)
* Proper grooming and conduct
* Attendance through official system

7\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1\. Monthly Booking Count

2\. Monthly Delivery Count

3\. Lead Generation Per Day

4\. Test Drives Conducted

5\. Conversion Rate (Lead → Booking)

6\. Follow\-Up Discipline

7\. Documentation Quality

8\. Customer Satisfaction Score

9\. Territory Coverage

10\. Competitor Intelligence Reports

8\. Code of Conduct (Ajmera Motors Standards)

* Be honest, respectful, and professional in all interactions.
* No false commitments or misrepresentation of offers.
* Follow Ajmera Motors’ pricing and discount policies strictly.
* Maintain clean records and transparency in documentation.
* Follow safety protocols during test drives.
* Avoid conflicts of interest and maintain integrity.
* No misuse of customer data or dealership resources.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹31,964\.02 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Provident Fund

This position is essential for maintaining long\-term relationships, increasing client retention, and enhancing the brand’s customer service experience.

* Provide updated project information, offer benefits, or alternative property options based on their requirements.

5\. Excellent command of English grammar, vocabulary, and professional tone.

6\. Experience with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Trends) and content management systems (WordPress, HubSpot, etc.).

7\. Familiarity with digital marketing metrics, keyword optimization, and user engagement analysis.

**Preferred Skills:**

1\. Experience in writing for technology or digital transformation industries.

3\. Adaptable to dynamic market trends and evolving brand strategies.

description:
**Job Title:** 




**Production Engineer – Equipment Assembly (Radiology \& Imaging Systems)** 




**Department:** 




 Production / Manufacturing – Radiology Division
 



**Location:** 




 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 




 Production Supervisor / Production Manager – Radiology Systems
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 To perform and supervise cable connections, fitting, and assembly operations for high\-precision
 **radiology and imaging systems** 
 such as
 **X\-Ray, C\-Arm, CT scan, DR system units** 
 , ensuring that all production activities meet stringent quality, safety, and performance standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Assembly and Wiring Operations** 



* Execute
 **electrical wiring, cable routing, crimping, and harness assembly** 
 for radiology and imaging equipment.
* Perform
 **mechanical fitting and sub\-assembly** 
 of modules including X\-ray tubes, detectors, high\-voltage generators, and gantry systems.
* Ensure accurate
 **integration of electrical, electronic, and mechanical components** 
 as per engineering drawings and assembly instructions.
* Conduct preliminary alignment and connection checks prior to system integration and testing.



**2\. Quality and Compliance** 



* Adhere strictly to
 **SOPs, assembly checklists, and work instructions** 
 throughout the production process.
* Perform
 **in\-process quality inspections** 
 and promptly identify electrical cable connections and mechanical defects.
* Ensure compliance with
 **ISO 13485, GMP, IEC safety standards, and ESD handling protocols.**
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and visual management standards in accordance with
 **5S and Lean Manufacturing** 
 principles.



**3\. Coordination and Technical Support** 



* Collaborate with
 **Design, Quality, and Testing** 
 teams to resolve assembly or electrical cable connection issues.
* Support the
 **testing, calibration, and validation** 
 of imaging systems during production trials.
* Provide technical feedback to enhance assembly methods, tooling efficiency, and product reliability.
* Assist in
 **new product introduction (NPI)** 
 by supporting prototype and pilot builds.



**4\. Documentation and Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate production logs, assembly records, and material usage reports.
* Record non\-conformities, assist in
 **root cause analysis** 
 , and contribute to corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Ensure full traceability of critical components and maintain documentation for audits and regulatory compliance.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* **Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech** 
 in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Biomedical Engineering.
* **3–5 years or more** 
 of experience in
 **assembly and electrical cable connection of medical imaging or electro\-mechanical equipment** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience in
 **high\-voltage wiring, PCB interfacing, harness assembly, and mechanical integration** 
 .
* Prior experience in
 **X\-Ray, C\-Arm, CT systems, or other diagnostic imaging equipment** 
 will be highly preferred.
* Familiarity with
 **CE and IEC safety compliance** 
 requirements for medical devices.



  





**Skills and Competencies:** 



* Strong practical skills in electrical wiring, assembly, and mechanical fitting.
* Ability to read and interpret
 **electrical schematics, electrical wiring diagrams, and mechanical layouts.**
* Understanding of
 **high\-voltage systems** 
 , grounding, and shielding techniques used in imaging devices.
* Attention to detail, precision, and adherence to process discipline.
* Effective troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication, teamwork, and documentation abilities.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 



* Accuracy and quality of system assembly and wiring
* On\-time completion of production schedules
* Reduction in rework, rejections, and downtime
* Compliance with quality and safety standards
* Implementation of process improvement initiatives

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
 As part of the Network Team, reporting into a functional team lead you will work with a wide variety of stakeholders including Service Delivery Managers, IT Architects and Systems Administrators to provide network expertise and operational support to all areas of the business
   

  

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Day to day operations management of network\-related incidents and service requests.
* Resolution or escalation of incidents and service requests within Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Management of network change communications and procedures within the Cubic change control framework.
* Monitor and report on network health using management tools including SolarWinds Network Performance Manager .
* Perform daily network health checks identify and rectify any potential issues in a timely manner.
* Install and commission network infrastructure platforms including switches, routers, firewalls and load balancers.
* Administer network protocols and technologies including: MPLS, BGP, OSPF, IPSEC, PVST, LCP.
* Create and maintain accurate, clear and comprehensive network documentation.
* Assist in the recommendation of new network equipment to meet project requirements
* Take responsibility for customer project deliverables.
* Provide 3rd line support, including out\-of\-hours support in critical incidents and participate in on\-call support.
* Comply with Cubic’s values and adherence to all company policy and procedures. In particular comply with the code of conduct, quality, security and occupational health, safety and environmental policies and procedures.
* In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the job holder is required to perform other duties assigned by their manager from time\-to\-time, as may be reasonably required of them.


**Minimum Job Requirements:**
* Degree, or equivalent experience, in a technical or technical management discipline plus 3 years of experience in Networking.
* Proven commercial experience in supporting large complex multi\-site LAN and WAN network solutions based predominantly on Cisco products.
* An in\-depth understanding of network infrastructure design and best practice principles including routing and switching concepts and technologies, advanced IP addressing, dynamic routing protocols. description:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients
   

  

 Min Experience: 3 years
   

  

 Location: Kolkata, Gujarat
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive
 **Network Engineer** 
 with
 **3\-7 years of hands\-on experience** 
 in managing, configuring, and optimizing enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in networking technologies, demonstrated through practical experience and a valid
 **Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)** 
 certification. This role is critical to ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and performance of network systems that power business operations.
   

  

**Requirements**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise\-level network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, and load balancers.
* Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to ensure minimal downtime and maximum efficiency.
* Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and patch management to ensure network stability and security compliance.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues at Layer 1\-Layer 7, providing root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective solutions.
* Configure and manage network routing and switching protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, VLANs, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and QoS policies.
* Manage network access control, security configurations, and VPN technologies (IPSec, SSL, Remote Access).
* Participate in network planning, capacity forecasting, risk analysis, and developing disaster recovery strategies.
* Implement, document, and maintain network architecture diagrams, SOPs, and technical configurations.
* Collaborate closely with IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, and DevOps teams to support system integration and seamless service delivery.
* Support network\-related aspects of office expansion, data center operations, cloud connectivity (AWS/Azure), and vendor coordination.
* Conduct proactive network monitoring using tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Wireshark, or similar platforms.


****Required Skills \& Qualifications****
* CCNA certification (mandatory); CCNP will be an added advantage.
* 3\-7 years of relevant experience in enterprise networking, preferably in mid to large\-scale environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar networking devices.
* Proficiency in TCP/IP fundamentals, LAN/WAN architecture, Firewall rules, NAT, DHCP, DNS, load balancing, and network segmentation.
* Experience with Wi\-Fi network deployment and wireless troubleshooting.
* Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and access control policies.
* Exposure to cloud networking and hybrid WAN technologies (SD\-WAN preferred).
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


****Good to Have****
* Experience with SD\-WAN solutions (Viptela, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with VOIP systems, SIP protocols, and Unified Communication platforms.
* Scripting knowledge for automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience in ITIL\-based service management processes

**About GTT**
 GTT provides secure global connectivity, improving network performance and agility for your people, places, applications, and clouds.  **www.gtt.net** 
**.**
**Role Summary**
 The
 **Network Engineer** 
 is a hybrid position with the primary role to assist in the smooth operation of GTT’s Global Network under the supervision of the Network Operations Manager. This is a large\-scale network spanning the globe and is built on a multi\-platform environment. The role is varied and demands a totally flexible approach to all tasks associated with this position.
   

  

**Job Scope/Supervision**
 The successful candidate should be comfortable working within an expanded and very fast\-paced team environment.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Assisting in customer test \& turn\-up (DWDM/ADM/Ethernet)
* Customer circuit troubleshooting with the aid of industry\-standard test equipment.
* Liaising with all GTT NOC Engineers and Network Operations departments in other countries
* Report writing and creating/maintaining inventories.
* Assisting in the management of a Planned Preventative Maintenance program and schedules
* Network installations / troubleshooting.
* Non\-routine duties will be allocated as deemed necessary.
* Training other members of staff when applicable.
* Generate site documentation such as maintaining records and files, preparing reports, and ordering supplies and equipment.
* Periodically inspect the equipment, locate, and correct problems before breakdowns occur.
* Ability to replace items such as circuit breakers, fuses, switches, lamps, electrical \& electronic components, and cable.
* When working with more complex items of plant, they may work with engineers, engineering technicians, or industrial machinery installation, repair, and maintenance workers.
* Supervise planned works, carrying out postmortems upon completion to assess the efficiency / financial worth and lessons learned from said works.
* Aim to constantly reduce operational running costs.
* Review / authorize and manage MOPS (method of procedures) RA’s (Risk Assessments) and back out plans prior to on\-site works taking place assessing all potential risks and consequences relating to specific works.
* Provide hands\-on and technical assistance during an emergency.


**Required Experience/Qualifications**
* Experience in optical networks and technical facilities required.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in an operational environment in a medium to large\-scale carrier / ISP would be a definite advantage.
* Experience in a role with hands\-on complex technical problem solving as a daily occurrence.
* Degree in Engineering related field – preferably Telecoms / Datacomms modules covered.
* Experience with hands\-on installs of power and telecoms equipment
* Strong Fiber management principles
* Experience with test equipment – OSA / OTDR / BERT / RFC 2544 test sets
* Experience with troubleshooting BGP, MPLS, VPLS, DSL, PPP, IP Routing and Switching technologies.
* A solid understanding of SONET/SDH principles is required.
* Experience with SDWAN, Fortinet, Aruba, and Silver Peak.
* Ethernet \& TCP/IP \& OSI experience is a distinct advantage.
* Optical network installation and troubleshooting skills will be an advantage.
* Responsibility for H\&S practices
* Management \& control of contractors
* Knowledge of network monitoring and other administrative tools
* Knowledge of networking technologies and protocols.
* Strong PC skills utilizing MS Office and industry\-standard software.
* Flexibility to assist in the 24 / 7 / 365 Network Operations Team.
* Strong knowledge of industry technologies/contacts and lead times
* Understanding of working in Data Centres and Comms Rooms/Exchanges.
* Competency in handling AC/DC power
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Self\-motivated
* Excellent written and communication skills
* Creative problem\-solving abilities


**Hours/Travel/Shift (Where Applicable)**
 Mainly US business hour shifts, rotational.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
* Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
* Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self\-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
* Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, and techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational, or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem\-solving appropriately to diverse situations.
* Root Cause Analysis: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, and techniques of root cause analysis (RCA); ability to use a structured approach to identify the underlying causes of problems in a particular environment and the changes needed to prevent recurrences.
* IP Technologies and Protocols: Knowledge of the features and policies of IP technologies and protocols; ability to configure, deploy and support IP\-based networks and services.
* IP\-based Services: Knowledge of the features and functions of IP\-based services; ability to configure, deploy and support TCP/IP\-based networks and associated services.
* Troubleshooting Network Problems: Knowledge of tools and techniques to troubleshoot network problems; ability to anticipate, recognize and resolve technical (network, hardware, software, equipment or operational) problems.


**Universal Competencies**
* Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes and enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results\-oriented.
* Customer First (Customer Facing): Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level.
* Operational Excellence: Understanding the system\-driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re\-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Human Resources Group, Human Resources Group \> Human Resources
   

  

**General Summary**
 HR Business Partner (HRBP) is responsible for aligning and implementing HR strategy and objectives with leadership at the engineering or business unit or division level. The position serves as a strategic consultant and trusted advisor to the leadership team on human resource\-related matters. Facilitates organization and leadership development efforts, working with senior leaders to address root causes of human resources issues. Develops and drives companywide programs and initiatives (e.g., talent management, succession planning, annual reviews \& rewards planning, workforce planning, and organizational design and change). Assists senior leadership in the development of solutions through cultural and process perspective organizational development.
   

  

 HR Business Partner takes the engineering or business unit or corporate function leadership through the calendar of HR events, acts as an employee champion, and serves as a change agent for the business. The HRBP proactively communicates with HR leaders and the appropriate global HR functions and seeks to develop integrated solutions. They will formulate partnerships across the global HR functions to deliver business value\- that reflect the business objectives of the organization. Viewed by the business as a strategic partner, change agent, and member of the extended leadership team.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities Include**
* Develop and implement an integrated organizational and people strategy, with both near\-term priorities and longer\-term initiatives, aligned to current and future business objectives for relevant client groups that proactively addresses all major HR areas, including talent acquisition, organizational or talent development, culture, leadership and career development, performance management, talent and succession planning, and total rewards.
* Lead strategic activities, such as talent discussions, business transactions (merger, acquisition, divestiture), employee engagement, organizational design, and change management and workforce planning (site/function strategy, expansion, restructuring)
* Provide expert advice and counsel to leaders on all organization and human resources matters to ensure strategic alignment and develop a high\-performance culture, including ongoing coaching and feedback related to leadership and team alignment and effectiveness, individual and group conflict resolution, and communication.
* Foster and reinforce company culture by ensuring leaders and employees are demonstrating and accountable to Qualcomm core values and leadership behaviors.
* Work collaboratively with HR Communities of Practice leaders (Talent, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, Employee Communications) \& People Solutions leaders to execute on the overall global HR strategy and to meet business needs.


**Required Skills**
* Strong business, financial, operational, competitor landscape, human resources acumen
* Ability to influence, consult, coach senior leaders and effectively communicate across all levels of organization.
* Data\-driven both in diagnosing business problems, understanding insights, and in providing HR solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to set and handle multiple competing priorities in the face of changing demand.
* Possesses both strategic thinking capability and “hands on” HR plan implementation experience.
* Role model for teamwork and skilled at fostering synergies amongst HRBPs, HR Communities of Practice (CPs) \& People Solutions (PS) teams to support an integrated HR delivery system.
* Strong change management experience and adaptability; ability to lead change management efforts.

 High School Diploma or equivalent and 11\+ years of HR\-related work experience.

title: Junior Network Engineer (India)
description:

Our growing suite of AI solutions spans ambient AI clinical documentation, provider copilots, autonomous coding, revenue cycle management and more — all designed for providers \& administrators to focus on what matters most: providing care.
   

  

 Healthcare is a $4\.5 trillion industry with more than $500 billion spent annually on administrative costs, and Commure is at the heart of transforming it. We power over 500,000 clinicians across hundreds of care sites nationwide – more than $10 billion flows through our systems and we support over 100 million patient interactions. With new product launches on the horizon, expansion into additional care segments, and a bold vision to tackle healthcare's most pressing challenges, our ambition is to move from upstart innovator to the industry standard over the next few years.
   

  

 Commure was recently named to Fortune’s Future 50 list for 2025 and is backed by world\-class investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Y Combinator, Lux, Human Capital, 8VC, Greenoaks Capital, Elad Gil, and more. Commure has achieved over 300% year\-over\-year growth for the past two years and this is only the beginning. Healthcare's moment for AI\-powered transformation is here, and we're building the technology to power it. Come join us in shaping the future of healthcare.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Junior Network Engineer** 
 to join our growing global Core Network Team. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in networking concepts, hands\-on experience with switching, routing, and firewalls, and a strong interest in network security and server administration. This is a great opportunity to work on complex enterprise environments, learn from experienced engineers, and grow rapidly in a dynamic global organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Assist in the configuration, deployment, and maintenance of network devices including switches, routers, firewalls, NAT, VPN, security policies, content filtering, intrusion prevention.
* Monitor network performance using tools such as PRTG, Zabbix, and respond to alerts to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Support day\-to\-day network operations, including troubleshooting connectivity issues, ISP monitoring \& troubleshooting
* Assist in server setup, configuration, and basic administration, including Windows and Linux servers.
* Participate in network security tasks, including basic penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and security hardening.
* Document network configurations, changes, and troubleshooting steps in a structured manner.
* Stay up to date with emerging network security.


**What You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical \& Electronic Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3\-4 years of relevant experience in networking or IT infrastructure
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing protocols, switching concepts, and network topologies.
* Hands\-on knowledge of firewall configuration and basic network security.
* Familiarity with server administration (Windows/Linux) and network services such as DHCP, DNS, VPN.
* Experience with network monitoring tools like PRTG, Zabbix, or similar.
* Knowledge of pentesting tools and basic security assessments is a plus.
* Knowledge of PFsense/OPNsense firewall is highly appreciated.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Proactive attitude with eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a global team.


**Preferred Certifications (Optional)**
* CCNA / CompTIA Network\+ / RHCSA
* Any relevant security certification (e.g., CEH, Security\+) will be an advantage.

 Primarily a Night Shift. Must be available for emergency or maintenance windows outside of normal hours.
   

  

 Commure is committed to creating and fostering a diverse team. We are open to all backgrounds and levels of experience, and believe that great people can always find a place. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants throughout the application process.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence.
   

  

 In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands\-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence.
   

  

 In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands\-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hard\-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational through proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems and restoring service to clients.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA) and focuses on second\-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity.
   

  

 The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyzes issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and log all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focused on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Coaches Service Desk and L1 teams for technical and behavioural skills.
* Establishes monitoring for client infrastructure.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non\-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.
* Able to handle Fortinet SDWAN enterprise network independently.


**Knowledge and Attributes:**
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
* Additional skills proficiency such as (but not limited to) \-
+ Pulse Secure SSL VPN / Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls / Cisco Nexus switches, ASR and ISR routers / Cisco ACS, ISE / Meraki switches and access points / Enterprise network architecture / Common routing protocols: BGP,OSPF, EIGRP / Network address translation / Configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting uplinks to ISPs for DIA, MPLS and P2P circuits / Familiarity with common network management and monitoring tools such as SecureCRT, Logic Monitor


**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* CCNP / NSE 3 or equivalent certification.
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).


**Required Experience:**
* Moderate level of relevant managed services experience.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. title: Network Administrator
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Network Administrator is responsible for handling advanced level support of Networking
 



 requests in a professional and timely manner. Network Administrator is a professional
 



 responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and reliable operation of an organization's
 



 computer networks.
 



  





**Education and Qualifications** 




 • Excellent communication skills.
 



 • Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in core network administration.
 



 • Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model.
 



 • Expert knowledge of networking concepts and protocols such as TCP/IP, DHCP, UDP,
 



 IPv4, 802\.11, QoS and routing.
 



 • Good Working knowledge of security aspects of networking interface that includes
 



 WPAx\-personal and WPAx\-Enterprise authentication protocols.
 



 • Proven Experience with network hardware and infrastructure such as routers, hubs,
 



 servers, VPNs, and switches for Local LANs, WANs and Wireless LANs
 



 • Configuring and maintaining various network hardware and software such as routers,
 



 switches servers and firewalls to ensure network security and efficiency.
 



 • Conducting maintenance of network and implementing network upgrade tasks such
 



 as installing new hardware or software, upgrading existing devices, or making changes
 



 to network configurations including security configurations.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 • Configure, install, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, and other network
 



 devices. Ensure network infrastructure is optimized, stable, and aligned with
 



 organizational standards and security protocols.
 



 • Continuously monitor network performance using monitoring tools, identifying
 



 bottlenecks, failures, or anomalies. Diagnose and resolve connectivity issues,
 



 outages, and performance degradation to ensure minimal downtime.
 



 • Implement and manage network security measures including firewalls, VPNs, access
 



 controls, and threat detection tools. Regularly review logs, patch vulnerabilities, and
 



 ensure compliance with security best practices.
 



 • Plan and execute network upgrades, hardware refreshes, and scalability initiatives.
 



 Work with cross\-functional teams to support infrastructure expansion, new site
 



 setups, and technology modernization projects.
 



 • Maintain network\-related backup systems and ensure accurate recovery procedures.
 



 Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to safeguard critical
 



 data and network availability.
 



 • Analyze traffic patterns and network utilization to fine\-tune configurations and
 



 improve efficiency. Recommend improvements to improve speed, reliability, and
 



 overall network performance.
 



  





**Our Culture and You** 




 What does the day in life look like for the Network Administrator? You come to work each
 



 day in an environment that promotes a community of collaboration and engagement. You
 



 work closely with a passionate and positive leadership team that is invested in your
 



 success. We work hard and have fun while dreaming big.
 



 Our employees have indicated that at IT by Design they find a home where their passion and
 



 career goals finally intersect for them to live a life full of purpose.
