description:
**Purpose of Position** – Manger Taxation in Finance organization, GVR India  

GVR India is seeking a Manager Taxation to lead the tax related responsibilities at Mumbai location. Reporting to the Financial Controller, he/she will be responsible the tax compliances of the Company – direct, indirect, transfer pricing, litigation and export regulations. The incumbent will oversee all preparations and support for the accounting and reporting for taxes, audits and assessments for statutory and group reporting. It is expected that he/she provides strategic inputs for tax planning and positioning in India markets.  

The tax lead will have future opportunities to take on expanded leadership roles within the GVR and / or Vontier organization.

**Key Responsibilities** \- The role and responsibilities will include:

* **Tax compliance:**
* Oversee the accurate calculation and timely payment of taxes.
* Filing of various tax returns and forms.
* Ensure compliance with the tax laws, both existing and changes – direct and indirect (income tax, GST)
* Accounting of the abovesaid taxes in the applicable GAAP.
* Prepare and review tax provisions and other disclosures for financial reporting.
* Tax reporting to GVR/Vontier Corp for group reporting.
* **Tax audits and assessments.**
* Handle all inquiries from tax authorities and audits
* Oversee the preparation of documents and supporting to be submitted.
* Respond to queries and prepare for tax audits and assessments.
* Work with the controlling and FP\&A team to report risk, contingent liabilities and countermeasure the same.
* **Tax planning and strategy:**
* Develop and implement strategies to optimise tax liability of the Company.
* Undertake analysis to support business decisions\-making.
* Collaborate with the broader finance and business teams to align tax planning and strategy to business goals.
* Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations to escalate risks and opportunities.
* **Business advisory and partnering:**
* Provide tax advice to management and stakeholders for transactions and operations.
* Oversee the inter\-company set up of global COE.
* Other tax related:
* Compliance to transfer pricing rules, both local and GVR/Vontier requirements and ensuring arms\-length pricing, billing and recovery across business areas
* Knowledge of foreign trade laws, EXIM, FEMA and GCC/COE and EOU set\-up is required.


\- Controls and compliance \- maintaining track of compliance, litigation matters and escalating the same.  

* Provide support to HR on employee payroll taxes including employee TDS deduction.
* **Others:**
* Work closely with advisors and consultants for optimising Company taxation.
* Tax\-related assistance in mergers, acquisition and other Corporate projects of Vontier/GVR processes.
* Practice Vontier Business Systems VBS by identify and drive continuous improvements through Kaizen.

  

Qualifications, requirements:  

To be a good fit for this opportunity you will have:  

* Chartered Accountant with eight\-twelve years of overall experience in finance, accounting or controlling with at least five years in taxation: direct, indirect. Transfer pricing and assessments/litigation.
* Should be well conversant with tax laws, changes and new developments.
* Experience in manufacturing set\-up and MNC background.
* Exposure to plant accounting, costing, FP\&A, and other areas of finance will be considered an added advantage.
* Knowledge of ERP and reporting systems (preferably, SAP and Hyperion) will be considered an added advantage.
* Should demonstrate strong financial acumen, critical thinking, problem\-solving thinking skills and the ability to make decisions.
* Highly analytical, data and detail\-oriented with ability to make decisions and work autonomously.
* Advanced Excel skills, command over MS Office applications and affinity to make presentations, as and when required.
* Strong compliance orientation to Vontier core value, tax laws, GAAP requirements, policies, SOX requirements.
* Excellent communication and people skills, ability to interact effectively with diverse levels and functions and build solid\-long term relationships.
* Experience of managing teams with proven record in employee engagement.
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability correspond with consultants and tax to convey technical financial information to non\-financial people.

Relationships  

* Reports to India Finance Director.
* Manage a team of internal and external tax resources including advisors and consultants.
* Strong working relationship with segment heads and cross functional teams.
* Close interface with factory, business and COE teams at various levels.
* Interface with other Corp GVR/Vontier and other Inter\-Companies, as required.

title: Global HR Shared Services Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You will be a key member of our Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC), supporting regional and local HR teams and employees worldwide with administrative HR processes. You’ll collaborate with colleagues across multiple geographies and time zones, forming part of a close\-knit global HR network that values teamwork, ownership, and continuous learning. In this role, you’ll lead a small to mid\-sized team and oversee the delivery of HR operations with a focus on quality, compliance, and continuous improvement. You’ll also act as a first point of escalation for complex queries, support process optimization efforts, and ensure performance targets are met through effective team management and process oversight.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the delivery of HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, data updates) in alignment with global policies and local compliance requirements.
* Oversee a team of HR coordinators or specialists, ensuring clarity in work allocation, productivity, and development.
* Monitor KPIs and SLAs to maintain service quality, and take timely action where improvements are needed.
* Act as an escalation point for process or service\-related issues, resolving them within defined guidelines and timelines.
* Ensure data integrity and system accuracy, particularly within tools such as Workday and case management systems.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
* Support readiness for internal and external audits by ensuring documentation and process adherence.
* Help create a positive and engaging team environment by providing guidance, feedback, and mentorship.

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of experience in HR operations or shared services, including 2–3 years in a team leadership role.
* Strong understanding of HR administration, processes, and compliance.
* Experience working in a global environment, including supporting multiple regions and managing diverse global stakeholders.
* Familiarity with HR systems such as Workday and case management tools.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment is a plus.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures with a collaborative mindset.
* Flexibility in work hours to support a global team and diverse stakeholders.

  

Who You'll Work With


Our HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC) spans across three global hubs—India, Costa Rica, and Portugal—delivering centralized and efficient support for HR processes worldwide. We support the full employee lifecycle with precision, enable efficiency gains through smart systems and collaboration, and deliver measurable outcomes that enhance every employee’s journey at BCG

  

Additional info

**You're Good At**

* Leading and supporting team members with empathy, clarity, and consistency.
* Managing day\-to\-day operations while keeping an eye on continuous improvement opportunities.
* Communicating effectively with team members, stakeholders, and peers across different regions.
* Prioritizing tasks and maintaining accuracy in a fast\-paced, service\-oriented environment.
* Solving operational challenges using sound judgment and a practical approach.
* Building collaborative relationships with others and contributing to a positive team dynamic.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.


* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.

**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.

 Employee Engagement \& Culture

**Job Summary**
 As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


 OR
   

  

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**
* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.
* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.
* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.
* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.


**Administering And Educating Employee Benefits**
* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.
* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.
* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.


**Managing Employee Development**
* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.
* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.
* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


**Maintaining Employee Relations**
* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).
* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.
* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.


**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**
* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.
* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.
* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

 Cross Office Staff (COS) interest.

* Analyze e\-commerce funnels: sessions → users → ATC → checkout → purchase.

* Measure performance of Meta, Google, YouTube, Influencer \& Retention campaigns.
* Track CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPM, Frequency, CPV, CAC Payback.

* Analyze product margins, top sellers, inventory health, pricing \& discounting impact.
* Work closely with Warehouse, Ops \& Customer Experience for SLA, delivery time, NDR, RTO \& return analysis.
* Support leadership with decision\-making dashboards for new store launches, product launches, demand forecasting.

**5\. Automation \& Advanced Analytics**

* Build automated pipelines (Sheets → Tableau/Power BI → MIS).
* Create predictive models for churn, lifetime value, and repeat buying patterns (optional but good to have).

**Required SkillsTechnical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **Excel / Google Sheets** (pivot, lookup, countifs, sumifs, array formulas).

**Analytical Skills**

* Strong data interpretation ability with a business mindset.
* Ability to convert raw data into actionable insights.
* Problem\-solving \& structured thinking (MECE mindset).
* Strong presentation skills (reports, decks, dashboards).

**Tools You’ll Work With (Optional but preferred)**

* Shopify
* Google Analytics
* Meta \& Google Ads dashboards
* EasyInsights / CleverTap / MoEngage / WebEngage
* ClickPost / Shiprocket
* Excel\-based MIS systems

* Freshers with strong analytical skills \& projects may also be considered.
* Someone who loves numbers and can work in a fast\-paced startup.
* High ownership, clarity of thinking, and bias for action.

**Why Join Divine Hindu**

* Work directly with founders \& leadership.
* High\-growth role with immense learning.

* Excellent communication skills—able to convert complex tech solutions into business insights.

The candidate must demonstrate the ability to train junior engineers and scale products rapidly.

description:
**Job description**

**Why Om Power Systems?**

of experience, operating in the Civil, Fabrication, Electrical, Mechanical \& Instrumentation sectors. This breadth of work suggests several reasons why civil and mechanical engineers might consider joining the company:

**1\. Diverse Project Exposure:**

* **Civil Engineers:** Om Power Systems undertakes "Civil Work" which includes projects like "building bridges between communities, one brick at a time," and general civil construction. This could involve infrastructure design and construction, requiring expertise in engineering, architecture, and project management. They also mention "Structural design and detailing, Execution and implementation of civil projects, Construction and maintenance of industrial infrastructure, Design and construction of large concrete silos or storage structures, Foundation work and related geotechnical aspects, Maintenance of existing civil assets in industrial settings." This implies a wide range of civil engineering challenges.
* **Mechanical Engineers:** The company's "Mechanical Work" involves "Crafting Motion, Engineering Excellence: The Heartbeat of Our Work." This includes the "design, development, installation, maintenance, and repair of various Mechanical systems and components, ranging from small\-scale mechanisms to large industrial machinery." They also mention experience with rotary equipment, heavy machinery, automated maintenance systems, and power plant engineering. This suggests varied mechanical engineering applications across industrial and power sectors.

**2\. Multi\-disciplinary Environment:**

* Om Power Systems is a "multi\-disciplinary services organization." This means civil and mechanical engineers would likely work alongside electrical, instrumentation, and fabrication teams. This cross\-functional collaboration can be invaluable for gaining a holistic understanding of complex projects and developing a broader skill set.

**3\. Experience and Growth:**

* With 15 years of experience, Om Power Systems has a track record in the industry. This could indicate stability and opportunities for career progression.
* Some job postings for similar companies indicate a preference for candidates with hands\-on experience in specific areas relevant to mechanical (e.g., rotary equipment, heavy machinery) and civil engineering (e.g., structural design, industrial infrastructure). This suggests a focus on practical application and skill development.

**4\. Industry Relevance:**

* Their work in "power systems" and "industrial power distribution" indicates involvement in a critical sector. Engineers interested in energy, infrastructure, and industrial development would find this appealing.

**5\. Commitment to Quality:**

* Om Power Systems states they are "widely recognized for its commitment to provide clients with the best quality products and services" and ensure "total customer satisfaction through continual improvement of its technology, infrastructure, workforce and services." This suggests a professional environment focused on high standards.

In summary, civil and mechanical engineers considering Om Power Systems would likely be attracted to the diverse project types, the opportunity to work in a multi\-disciplinary setting, and the potential for gaining practical experience in a relevant industry.

Working at Om Power Systems as a Civil or Mechanical Engineer could offer several benefits, particularly given its focus on power systems and industrial infrastructure in India. While specific employee benefits and reviews for Om Power Systems directly are not extensively detailed in general searches, we can infer some advantages based on the company's profile and industry standards:

**Summary:**

* Variety across industries \& large\-scale clients
* Growth with continual learning and structured roles
* Stability in a regulated, quality\-driven environment
* Work\-life \& culture backed by strong employee satisfaction

**Key Responsibility for Civil Engineer Jobs at Om Power Systems**

When looking at job responsibilities for both Civil and Mechanical Engineers at Om Power Systems, it's essential to consider the company's core business in power systems, industrial infrastructure, and multi\-disciplinary services in India. This implies a significant focus on project execution, site management, and interdisciplinary coordination.

Here's a combined outlook on their key responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities for Civil Engineers at Om Power Systems**

Civil Engineers at Om Power Systems will primarily be involved in the foundational and structural aspects of power and industrial projects. Their responsibilities would largely centre around:

* **Site Assessment \& Preparation:**
* Conducting thorough **site investigations** to assess soil conditions (geotechnical aspects), topography, and overall site suitability for heavy industrial construction.
* Overseeing **earthwork, excavation, and backfilling** operations.
* Planning and executing **site leveling, grading, and drainage** systems.
* **Design \& Detailing (often reviewing and adapting existing designs):**
* Interpreting and implementing **detailed engineering drawings** for civil structures.
* Focusing on **foundations for heavy machinery** (turbines, generators, transformers, boilers), ensuring they can withstand significant static and dynamic loads.
* Designing and overseeing the construction of **industrial buildings** (control rooms, switchgear buildings, administrative blocks), specialized **concrete structures** (e.g., cooling towers, large silos, water treatment facilities), and access roads.
* Ensuring **structural integrity and stability** of all civil components according to relevant Indian standards and codes (e.g., IS codes).
* **Construction Execution \& Supervision:**
* **Directly supervising** all civil construction activities on\-site, ensuring work is carried out as per design, specifications, and schedule.
* **Quality control and assurance:** Conducting rigorous inspections of materials (e.g., concrete, steel) and workmanship, performing necessary tests, and maintaining detailed quality records. This includes checking product quality and dimensions.
* **Resource management:** Optimizing the use of labor, equipment, and materials on the construction site.
* **Progress monitoring:** Tracking construction progress, identifying potential delays, and implementing corrective actions to keep the project on track.
* **Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance:** Strictly enforcing safety protocols and environmental regulations on site to ensure a safe working environment.
* **Coordination \& Communication:**
* **Inter\-disciplinary coordination:** Liaising extensively with mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation engineers to ensure seamless integration of civil works with other systems. For example, ensuring equipment foundations align with mechanical layouts.
* **Contractor and vendor management:** Coordinating with and supervising civil contractors, subcontractors, and material suppliers.
* **Client interaction:** Communicating project updates, addressing concerns, and resolving issues with client representatives.
* **Reporting:** Preparing and presenting regular progress reports, technical reports, and documentation.

**Key Responsibilities for Mechanical Engineers at Om Power Systems**

Mechanical Engineers at Om Power Systems will be critical in the design, installation, operation, and maintenance of the mechanical systems that form the heart of power and industrial facilities. Their responsibilities would include:

* **System Design \& Engineering:**
* Designing, analysing, and optimizing **mechanical systems** for power generation (e.g., turbine\-generator sets, boilers, heat exchangers) and industrial processes.
* Developing designs for **piping systems**, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) for industrial buildings, firefighting systems, and material handling systems.
* Selecting and specifying **mechanical equipment and components** based on performance requirements, efficiency, cost\-effectiveness, and industry standards.
* Performing **fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and stress analyses** to ensure optimal performance and safety of mechanical systems.
* **Equipment Procurement \& Installation:**
* Assisting in the **technical evaluation and selection of vendors** for mechanical equipment.
* Overseeing the **installation, erection, and alignment of heavy machinery** and various mechanical systems on site.
* Ensuring proper **calibration and commissioning** of mechanical equipment, verifying functionality and performance as per design.
* **Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) Support:**
* Developing **preventive and predictive maintenance strategies** for mechanical assets to maximize uptime and extend equipment life.
* **Troubleshooting and resolving mechanical breakdowns** and operational issues.
* Implementing **maintenance schedules** and overseeing repair activities for rotary and static equipment.
* Optimizing **energy efficiency** and performance of mechanical systems during operation.
* **Quality Assurance \& Safety:**
* Ensuring all mechanical installations and operations comply with **safety standards, environmental regulations, and industry best practices.**
* Conducting **quality inspections** of mechanical components, fabrication works, and installations.
* Performing **risk assessments** related to mechanical systems and implementing mitigation measures.
* **Inter\-disciplinary Collaboration:**
* **Collaborating closely with civil engineers** (on equipment foundations and supports), electrical engineers (on motor drives, controls), and instrumentation engineers (on system automation).
* Working with project managers to ensure mechanical aspects align with overall project goals, budget, and schedule.
* **Interacting with vendors and suppliers** for technical clarifications, material quality, and delivery schedules.
* **Reporting:** Documenting mechanical designs, test results, maintenance logs, and operational reports.

Both roles at Om Power Systems would likely demand a strong understanding of **Indian industrial project environments**, a **hands\-on approach**, and excellent **communication and coordination skills** due to the multi\-disciplinary nature of their projects.

**General Eligibility for Both Civil \& Mechanical Engineers:**

* **Education:** A **Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech)** in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university/institution is almost certainly a fundamental requirement.
* While the "Site Engineer" job posting mentioned "Graduate," in the Indian context for engineering roles, this almost universally refers to a B.E./B.Tech degree.
* For more specialized or senior roles, a Master's degree (M.E./M.Tech) might be preferred or required.
* **Location Preference:** Willingness to work on\-site, particularly in locations like Navi Mumbai, and potentially other project sites across India.
* **Gender Preference:** "Both male and female can apply" is explicitly stated in the Site Engineer role, indicating an inclusive hiring policy.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong communication (verbal and written), teamwork, problem\-solving, analytical skills, and attention to detail are crucial for site\-based engineering roles.

**Preferred Skills \& Tools**

* **Problem\-Solving Abilities:** Essential for addressing on\-site challenges, construction delays, and unexpected issues.
* **Communication Skills:** Clear and effective communication (written and verbal) to convey technical details to contractors, clients, and internal teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** Precision in planning, design, and execution is critical in civil engineering.
* **Teamwork \& Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively with multi\-disciplinary teams (mechanical, electrical, fabrication, instrumentation).
* **Project Management Skills:** Understanding project planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and risk management.
* **Adaptability to New Technologies:** Willingness to learn and adopt new software, tools, and construction methodologies.
* **Safety Consciousness:** A strong commitment to on\-site health and safety.
* **Manufacturing \& Fabrication Knowledge:**
* Understanding of various manufacturing processes such as machining, welding, casting, forging, and additive manufacturing (3D printing).
* Knowledge of material science and selection for different applications in industrial environments (e.g., high temperature, corrosive environments).
* **Piping Design \& Analysis (for some roles):**
* Familiarity with piping design software (e.g., Aveva PDMS, SP3D, AutoPLANT) for 3D modeling of piping layouts, clash detection, and stress analysis (using tools like CAESAR II).
* **Control Systems \& Automation (Mechatronics):**
* Basic understanding of PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) programming, sensors, actuators, and control loops, especially for automated industrial machinery and power plant controls.
* **Maintenance \& Reliability Tools:**
* Knowledge of condition monitoring techniques (vibration analysis, thermal imaging).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (like SAP PM module) for maintenance planning and inventory management.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Analytical Thinking \& Problem\-Solving:** Crucial for diagnosing mechanical issues, optimizing system performance, and developing innovative solutions.
* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Essential for working with other disciplines, clients, and vendors, especially during equipment installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
* **Attention to Detail:** Precision in design, assembly, and maintenance of mechanical systems is paramount.
* **Project Management \& Organization:** Ability to manage mechanical project aspects, schedules, and resources.
* **Adaptability \& Continuous Learning:** The mechanical engineering field, especially in power systems, is constantly evolving with new technologies (e.g., renewable energy, automation).
* **Safety \& Regulatory Compliance:** Strong understanding and adherence to industrial safety standards and mechanical codes.

In summary, Om Power Systems would likely seek engineers who are not only technically proficient in their specific discipline but also possess strong practical skills for site execution, excellent communication abilities, and the capacity to work collaboratively within a multi\-disciplinary industrial project environment.

at the national and international levels.

 Identify, evaluate, and onboard potential institutional partners in alignment with the

organization’s strategic goals.

 Serve as the primary liaison between the institution and partner organizations to

lead conversion.

service delivery and institutional satisfaction.

**4\. Reporting, Documentation \& Insights**

 Maintain comprehensive records of institutional engagements, event outcomes,

partnership activities, and follow\-up actions.

 Prepare periodic performance reports, impact assessments, and dashboards to

support strategic planning and decision\-making.

 Provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership for continuous

improvement and growth of institutional networks.

**2\. Marketing Strategy Development \& Execution**

**Key Responsibilities**

** Develop and Execute Multi\-Channel Marketing Strategies:**

Design and implement integrated marketing campaigns tailored to the education sector, with a specific focus on the regional dynamics of Kerala and South India. Leverage both digital and traditional media channels to maximize reach and engagement.

** Set Strategic Marketing Objectives:**

Define clear short\-term and long\-term marketing goals that align with the academy’s student enrolment targets, brand positioning, and overall business growth trajectory.

** Student Acquisition \& Campaign Management**

Lead integrated marketing campaigns to drive lead generation and student enrollments.

** Brand Development and Managemen**t Build, manage, and evolve the Academy’s brand identity to reflect quality, innovation, and employability. Ensure consistent branding across all physical and digital touch points. Cultivate a strong brand reputation in the education and corporate sectors.

**3\. Digital Marketing and Online Presence**

** Website Management and Optimization:** Oversee the academy's website, ensuring it is user\-friendly, informative, and optimized for search engines (SEO). Implement strategies to improve website traffic, engagement, and lead generation.

**4\. Counseling \& Student Advising**

**Student Recruitment and Outreach**

1\. Actively recruit students by visiting high schools, colleges, and technical institutions to promote academic programs and opportunities.

2\. Represent the institution at educational fairs, information sessions, conferences, and other recruitment events.

3\. Develop and implement an individual recruitment plan outlining activities, event participation, communication strategies, and networking opportunities.

4\. Build and maintain a database of schools, teachers, administrators, and key contacts for organizing workshops and information sessions.

7\. Conduct phone campaigns, email outreach, and face\-to\-face meetings to inform applicants about admission procedures, courses offered, and key deadlines.

8\. Assist students throughout the admission process by answering queries and helping them complete required documentation.

9\. Collaborate with program coordinators to organize presentations, webinars, and campus\-based recruitment activities.

**Admissions Support and Operations**

10\. Maintain performance metrics by converting inquiries into confirmed admissions and achieving set enrolment goals.

11\. Coordinate admission\-related tasks such as student registration, entrance testing, and documentation.

12\. Create and maintain applicant profiles, working collaboratively with fellow counsellors during the review and final approval process.

**Professionalism and Continuous Development**

14\. Demonstrate the ability to work independently, manage appointments, and conduct information sessions effectively.

15\. Maintain a high standard of professionalism by treating colleagues, students, and visitors with courtesy and respect.

To ensure a healthy work\-life balance, you'll have one scheduled day off during the weekdays. If you extend your support on a Sunday, we ensure you receive your weekly off on a weekday.

**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Job**
 The Technical Writer is responsible for creating, managing, and continuously improving technical documentation for Black Box’s product portfolio, with a strong focus on KVM, AV, and IoT solutions that enable our Control Room \& Command Center strategy. This role works closely with Product Management, R\&D, and cross\-functional teams to ensure documentation is accurate, user\-friendly, and aligned with product lifecycles and customer needs. The writer will also leverage AI\-driven tools and processes to enhance efficiency, consistency, and scalability of content development.
   

  

**Primary Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, including Technical Data Sheets, Application Notes, Product Specification Sheets, Reference Manuals, Training Documentation, How\-To Guides, and Technical Web Content for internal and external audiences.
* Collaborate with Product Management and R\&D teams to ensure documentation accurately reflects product features, functionality, and updates across the KVM, AV, and IoT product portfolio.
* Apply AI\-based content development and editing tools to improve authoring, translation, content reuse, and version control.
* Translate complex technical ideas into clear, concise, and engaging content for diverse audiences (administrators, system integrators, developers, non\-technical users).
* Study internal processes, drawings, specifications, mockups, and product samples to create precise and usable procedures.
* Analyze existing and potential content to maintain continuity in voice, style, and technical accuracy across all documentation.
* Manage updates and revisions across channels (web, print, partner portals) and ensure accuracy across all systems.
* Support the development of control room strategy content, highlighting how Black Box solutions integrate and provide value.
* Anticipate documentation challenges and propose proactive solutions to ensure high\-quality deliverables within project timelines.


**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities**
* Exceptional writing, editing, and communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proficiency with AI\-powered content creation/editing tools and openness to adopting emerging technologies in documentation.
* Effective collaboration skills with Product Management, Engineering, and R\&D teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, product specifications, and business processes.
* Strong organizational and project management skills; capable of balancing multiple priorities.
* Ability to mentor and share best practices across the business.
* Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate documentation strategy to leadership and stakeholders.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Technical Writing, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Technical/Engineering education is preferred.
* 3\+ years of technical writing experience, preferably in high\-tech product manufacturing or related industries.
* Experience working with documentation management systems, AI\-driven authoring tools, MS Office, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Familiarity with KVM, AV, IoT, or related Control Room technology domains preferred.

**Your Hunger for Innovation Starts Here.**

We are an early\-stage startup that rejects standard practices, looking for an unconventional thinker ready to embrace the hardest challenges and define our technical future.

**The Mission: Build Solutions That Leave Impact**

Your primary responsibility is to own the full development cycle and ensure that every feature you build solves a problem in a non\-obvious, impactful way.

● Commitment to Impact: You will drive projects from concept to deployment, operating with the clear goal of delivering measurable value. We prioritize clever solutions and high\-impact features over rote development.

● Out\-of\-the\-Box Problem Solving: You will be faced with vague, complex challenges. Your expertise lies not just in writing code, but in conceptualizing and executing non\-standard technical solutions that bypass conventional roadblocks.

● AI Adaptability \& Pioneer Spirit: You will actively seek opportunities to integrate AI inclusion (LLMs, ML models, generative capabilities) into our core products. This requires a willingness to experiment and rapidly prototype with transformative technology.

● End\-to\-End Ownership: From designing the database and scalable backend APIs to engineering responsive, high\-quality user interfaces, you take total, unmitigated responsibility for the final product.

We require fundamental full\-stack knowledge—enough to be dangerous—but your mindset

and capacity for rapid self\-learning are the true differentiators.

Java) and experience with associated frameworks.

○ Familiarity with modern front\-end concepts (HTML, CSS, modern frameworks like

React/Vue/Angular).

○ Basic competence in database management (SQL/NoSQL) and API architecture

(REST).

○ Basic Understanding of AI : LLMs, ML models, generative capabilities

○ Comfortable with AI tools like ChatGPT, Google Gemini etc.

finding creative, often simpler, ways to solve complex problems.

**If you are prepared to join a team where the challenges are hard, the growth is fast, and the impact is everything, we want to hear from you.**

description:
**Background** 




 Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep\-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.
 







**Why** 




 Everyone worries about the dooms\-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.
 







**Job Description** 



* Work directly with our Founder to understand global talent requirements and accordingly formulate a strategic, priority\-based hiring plan
* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from defining role requirements, sourcing and interviewing candidates, to overseeing offers, onboarding, development, engagement and offboarding
* Ensure new hires have a smooth onboarding experience and are well introduced to Praan’s culture, tools, systems and teams
* Manage employee relations by conducting pulse surveys, organizing team events, driving engagement and culture\-building initiatives
* Create, update, and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, performance review frameworks and compensation or benefits structures
* Support goal\-setting, performance reviews, and feedback discussions while driving recognition and improvement programs
* Identify training needs across teams, design learning programs and support development and career growth initiatives
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, ensure compliance with local labour laws and manage payroll and benefits coordination
* Work closely with our Founder to shape and strengthen Praan’s culture, promoting openness, accountability and collaboration



  





**Skill Requirements** 



* 3\-7 years of HR experience (generalist or talent\-focused) in a startup or fast\-scaling company
* Proven experience hiring for engineering and technical roles (hardware, embedded, software, manufacturing, etc.)
* Ability to understand and communicate complex technical requirements
* Strong interpersonal, communication and relationship\-building skills
* Pragmatic, proactive and comfortable with ambiguity
* Deep care for people, culture and purpose \- not just process
* High energy, passion for learning and bias for action



  





**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

 Bengaluru (Hybrid)
   

  

**People Manager:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Graphcore is a UK\-headquartered semiconductor and AI compute company, now part of SoftBank’s global AI ecosystem. Our headquarters are in Bristol, with offices in London, Cambridge, Poland, Germany, and Taiwan. In 2025, we are expanding into India with a new entity and office based in Bengaluru — a key hub for engineering, operations, and growth.
   

  

 Our mission is to build the future of AI compute – and that depends not only on exceptional engineering but also on an outstanding People function. As we scale globally, the People team is focused on building strong operational foundations and great employee experience everywhere we operate.
   

  

 The People Lead – India will be our first senior People Enablement hire in\-country, playing a pivotal role in standing up our India entity and shaping its success. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact generalist position covering the employee lifecycle, ensuring India compliance, operational excellence, and strong local partnerships.
   

  

 You will be part of the Global People Team, reporting into the Senior Director of People Operations in the UK, and collaborating with the wider People Operations, Business Partner, and Talent teams.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 You will own the delivery of all People Enablement activities for our India entity, from onboarding to offboarding, while ensuring we meet all statutory, policy, and compliance requirements.
   

  

 This role will act as the local point of contact for India employees and managers, collaborating closely with global colleagues in People, Finance, Workplace, and Engineering to ensure smooth operations and a consistent global experience.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor to managers and engineers, you will help them build and grow great teams — providing practical guidance, ensuring strong people practices, and fostering an inclusive and high\-performance culture.
   

  

 You will work closely with the People Operations Adviser currently supporting setup activities, providing direction, and mentoring as operations mature. You will also partner with key vendors including payroll and benefits brokers, and local compliance partners.
   

  

 As our footprint grows, you will help us move from 0 to 100\+ employees – building while flying – creating scalable processes, supporting team environments, and continuously improving our ways of working.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
**Operational Delivery**
* Lead delivery of all People Operations activities for the India entity – onboarding, employment changes, HRIS updates, benefits enrolments, and leavers.
* Partner with managers and engineers to enable smooth onboarding, transitions, and people processes that support team growth and engagement.
* Oversee payroll inputs and monthly cycles in partnership with Finance and payroll provider.
* Maintain and update India employee files, HR registers, and statutory records in line with local requirements.
* Partner with Workplace and IT on onboarding, asset tracking, and workspace readiness.
* Partner with auditors to ensure accuracy and compliance of employee documentation and processes.


**Compliance and Governance**
* Ensure compliance with India labour law, statutory benefits (EPF, ESIC, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment Act), and record\-keeping obligations.
* Establish and coordinate the POSH Committee, ensuring compliance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act.
* Liaise with auditors, and regulators on People\-related compliance and filings.
* Maintain awareness of evolving employment legislation and update policies and processes accordingly.


**Vendor and Partner Management**
* Act as the day\-to\-day relationship lead for payroll, benefits, and HR service providers to ensure smooth delivery of people's operations.
* Partner with Finance, Workplace, and Legal teams to ensure alignment on operational and compliance matters.
* Manage renewals, service improvements, and issue resolution with all vendors.


**Employee And Manager Experience**
* Provide high\-quality employee support across the lifecycle – contracts, letters, benefits queries, and general HR advice.
* Support and coach managers and engineers on People policies, employee relations, and day\-to\-day management practices to help build healthy, high\-performing teams.
* Support employee engagement activities, wellbeing initiatives, and policy awareness.
* Promote consistency with Graphcore’s global People processes while adapting for local needs.
* Foster and promote the company’s culture of collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement through everyday interactions and people programs


**Process Improvement and Projects**
* Build, document, and refine local HR processes, workflows, and templates.
* Identify opportunities to automate or simplify manual steps through HRIS tools and data.
* Support global People initiatives such as policy alignment, HRIS upgrades, and process mapping.
* Contribute to global People Enablement discussions, sharing India insights and improvements.


**Candidate Profile**
**Essential**
* \[10 years plus] strong relevant Experience in People Operations or HR Generalist Lead roles
* Strong working knowledge of India statutory requirements and employment law.
* Experience managing HR vendors and external partners (e.g., payroll, benefits, HR services).
* Skilled in HR systems and data management.
* Proven ability to manage workflows, prioritise effectively, and deliver high\-quality outcomes under time pressure.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills across cultures and time zones.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change – able to build structure while scaling rapidly.
* Experience leading or mentoring a small team.


**Desirable**
* Experience working in a global or technology/engineering environment.
* Exposure to setting up or supporting new entities or international offices.
* Familiarity with global HRIS, benefits, and compliance frameworks.


**Mindset and Approach**
* Values collaboration over hierarchy and builds trust through openness and involvement.
* Is confident and knowledgeable, yet curious and humble enough to learn from others.
* Enjoys working in a fast iterative environment – building while flying.
* Balances structure with pragmatism, and compliance with a people\-first approach.
* Motivated by helping managers and engineers build great teams.

description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As part of our HR Shared Services team, you will lead and be accountable for the successful delivery of HR operational processes across various geographies. You will focus on continuous process improvement and expanding the scope of services delivered, while maintaining process KPIs and SLAs. Partnering with Regional HR and other functional teams, you will facilitate, support, and execute organizational procedures and participate in transformational initiatives as needed. As HR Shared Services grows, we seek a seasoned HR Shared Services Leader for our Delhi office, capable of scaling with our organization through its transformation.

  

Responsibilities include, but is not limited to:

* Lead and oversee all HR operational processes related to the employee lifecycle, ensuring alignment with regional compliances and organizational policies, and provide strategic direction to the team.
* Maintain and monitor service level KPIs and SLAs for all processes.
* Allocate work effectively to improve team productivity and ensure high efficiency, with mechanisms to measure performance metrics.
* Administer and maintain Workday data points to ensure 100% data accuracy and integrity.
* Manage and resolve escalated queries within defined timelines and organizational guidelines.
* Harmonize HR processes across business units/geographies and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Achieve targets and performance standards expected from the Shared Services organization.
* Participate in internal and external audits as required.
* Develop a future\-focused HR Shared Services strategy to evolve the HR shared services function.
* Identify and implement service improvement activities using process improvement methodologies and innovative thinking.
* Understand business goals and market trends to recommend and influence new approaches.
* Continuously evaluate the HRSSC service with key stakeholders and customers, using feedback and operational data to improve overall service.
* Plan and execute strategies, identifying root causes of operational issues.
* Build relationships with the HRSSC team and stakeholders for better efficiency and responsiveness.
* Identify and execute opportunities to expand service activities based on stakeholder feedback.

 **Building Relationships and Collaboration**

* Build partnerships with stakeholders within business units, functional departments, and other teams.
* Work within culturally diverse teams, fostering relationships to drive consensus and alignment across stakeholder groups.
* Problem Solving, Analytical Skills, and Decision Making

 **Identify opportunities and propose projects to improve processes and systems.**

* Solve day\-to\-day operational issues using strong analytical skills to meet user, business, and group requirements.
* Organize and prioritize work across a broad range of topics, effectively managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and constraints.

 **Work Management, Organization, and Planning**

* Manage and organize the growing resources of the team to ensure availability when needed.
* Keep system training documentation up to date for key stakeholders.

 **Customer and Business Focus**

* Be pragmatic, exhibit high energy, and demonstrate personal and professional self\-confidence.

  

What You'll Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Organization Development, or a related field is required.
* Minimum of 15\-20 years of progressive experience in a global and matrixed environment, providing guidance and influence to leaders.
* Experience in managing and leading teams in an HR shared service environment that offers a wide range of services across the full employee lifecycle.
* A track record of reliable delivery and continuous improvement in a shared service environment.
* Knowledge of HR compliance, administration, generalist activities, and management information (MI) reporting.
* Strong understanding of Data Protection legislation and experience managing data requests.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to juggle competing priorities.
* Ability to influence leaders and build relationships across the organization.
* Project management experience to deliver operational excellence.
* Comfort working in detail while understanding the big picture.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Slack, Trello, Egnyte, HR Management systems like Workday, and Case Management software is a plus.
* Flexibility to support a diverse, international set of stakeholders and willingness to be flexible with office timings.

BCG’s Global HR Teams as well as international stakeholders across a range of cohorts and functions. You will report into the


HR Shared Services –Director within the Global HR Team.

title: HR Partner
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, IXT, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with the HR Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. As a subject matter expert, the HR Partner mentors and guides junior team members.
   

  

* Performance Management: Support managers through complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to identify process improvement opportunities and standardize best practices due to our extensive insights across business lines.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or related field
* 3\-5 years’ relevant experience in the areas of HR Partnering
* Strong HR acumen, including strong problem\-solving skills, critical thinking and analysis
* Experience working in a highly matrixed organization.
* Ability to identify problems and drive appropriate solutions independently
* Proven track record of successfully partnering with senior\-level stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field
* Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven
* Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources
* Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations
* Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders
* Experience developing and implementing country level or regional HR programs or initiatives


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
 As part of the Cubic Transportation Systems India HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP) is responsible for aligning business objectives with employees and management for their designated area. They build strong strategic partnerships with their assigned leader(s) to develop, solution and implement people plans to include effective organization design, development and change management. Responsible for shaping and delivering effective outcomes to meet the business objectives and deadlines. They maintain up\-to\-date business knowledge of their assigned areas, and as part of the global HR team work collaboratively with the COE’s to provide effective HR services across Talent Acquisition, Total reward, Talent management, Employee relations and compliance.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director HR, India this position works under limited supervision and direction. Incumbent will regularly exercise discretionary and substantial decision\-making authority.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Partners with the designated leader(s) to create and implement solutions to meet the business objectives across all areas of people management. Accountable for delivering outcomes to the required deadlines.
* Builds strong, effective relationships and gain in\-depth business knowledge including the annual operating plan (AOP), strategic plan, financial performance, competitors, and culture.
* Consults with line management, providing HR guidance and coaching when appropriate drawing on best practice, company policy and procedures, local law, and compliance.
* Develops strong working relationship with the HR functional COE’s to enable effective HR service delivery and solutions aligned to the assigned area’s business objectives. Actively encourages the use of self\-service tools.
* Shapes culture, keep pulse on employee engagement, working closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale and retention. Interpret employee engagement survey feedback and able to develop actions plans to address gaps.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the talent within your assigned area to inform decisions that align with strategic outcomes. Collaborate with business leaders to critically assess current and future talent needs, including performance, potential, and readiness for growth opportunities. Utilize data and insights to guide these talent decisions effectively.
* Able to coach, mentor and effectively communicate HR concepts including performance, succession planning and talent programs. May be required to deliver training from time to time.
* Provide guidance on job design in accordance with the Cubic job architecture framework, collaborating with the compensation team to determine appropriate grade and salary levels. Assist business leaders in the interviewing process for senior roles.
* Develops and implements strategies to help the organization manage periods of change such as business restructures, growth or reduction, acquisitions, and functional and enterprise change programs. Guides and drafts change plans and associated communications.
* Proactive to analyse and provide data insight (supported by COE’s) to inform effective decision making and aligned to the business KPIs. Able to present and discuss data, developing corrective actions plans as needed.
* Supports complex employee relations matters in partnership with employee relations and legal department
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends and local employment legislation, able to upskill as required.
* May be required to assist and/or lead HR projects as requested. Provide support and back up to colleagues as required.
* In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the job holder is required to perform other duties assigned by their manager from time\-to\-time, as may be reasonably required of them.


**Minimum Job Requirements:**
* College degree in Human Resources or business area plus eight years of experience working as an HR generalist.
* Must have a track record of providing strategic HR Business Partnering within IT, engineering, or service business supporting senior levels. Prior experience of working within a global HR team desirable.
* Working knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines, including talent acquisition, development, job design and compensation practices, diversity and inclusion, data analytics and performance management.
* Must have an up to date and working knowledge of employment law and current HR trends. Ability to comprehend, interpret, and apply the appropriate sections of applicable laws, guidelines, regulations, ordinances, and policies.
* Must demonstrates the ability to apply in\-depth professional knowledge and experience to solution complex matters that align with the company objectives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management: able to build effective networks across the business at all levels and demonstrates the ability to influence outcomes.
* Ability to collaborate, with the interpersonal skills to communicate at all levels of the organization.
* Ability to work at pace with a proven ability to manage to a deadline, manage ambiguity and adapt to change. Ability to protect and handle confidential personnel information.
* Demonstrates background in supporting employee engagement initiatives, driving a culture of diversity and inclusion.
* Ability to acquire a thorough understanding of the organization’s hierarchy, jobs, qualifications, compensation practices, and the administrative practices related to those factors.
* Self\-learner and stays informed to latest HR trends


 Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer required. Must be able to travel to visit assigned sites on a regular basis.
   

  

**Worker Type:**
 Employee

 Student / Fresher / Career switcher – as long as you can code in React.

* Real\-time project experience in a live AI product

* Understanding how users interact with career tools
* Internship certificate on successful completion
* Option for Letter of Recommendation (LOR) based on performance
* Your work will be visible in a real product (good for resume \& portfolio)
