title: Junior Network Engineer
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a proactive and technically sound Network L1 Engineer to join our global 24x7 network operations team. The role involves first\-level support for enterprise network infrastructure, issue triaging, and collaboration with L2 teams for resolution. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in a corporate or enterprise networking environment, with a solid foundation in L1\-level troubleshooting and incident response.
   

  

**Note**
 Please
 **do not apply** 
 if your experience is primarily in
 **ISP NOC** 
 ,
 **telecom core networks** 
 ,
 **customer provisioning** 
 ,
 **desktop support, field support for ISP/telecom/banking** 
 , or
 **L1 monitoring roles.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide first\-line support for enterprise network issues including WAN, LAN, VPN, and wireless
* Perform initial L1\-level troubleshooting of routers, switches, firewalls, wireless controllers
* Manage and triage alerts; escalate as needed to L2 teams with preliminary analysis.
* Support basic network configurations, connectivity testing, and hardware health checks
* Ensure timely logging, categorization, and documentation of incidents and service requests
* Execute standard operating procedures (SOPs) and follow predefined runbooks for repetitive tasks
* Assist in collecting logs, configuration data, and other artifacts for deeper analysis by L2/L3 teams
* Work in rotational shifts for 24x7 global operations including night and weekend coverage
* Maintain shift handover notes and status updates to ensure operational continuity
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and vendors on ticket updates and follow\-ups


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Total Experience: 2 to 3 years
* Relevant Network Experience (Enterprise/Corporate): 1 to 2 years
* Proven hands\-on L1\-level experience with enterprise networking technologies


 (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, etc.)
   

  

* Familiarity with network security best practices and configurations
* Ability to work in 24x7 shift operations, including night/weekend rotations


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelors in Computer Science/IT/Electronics Engineering, M.C.A. or equivalent University degree
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network\+ or equivalent
* Strong documentation, verbal and written communication skills
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence.
   

  

 In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands\-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Lexmark is now a proud part of Xerox, bringing together two trusted names and decades of expertise into a bold and shared vision.
   

  

 When you join us, you step into a technology ecosystem where your ideas, skills, and ambition can shape what comes next. Whether you’re just starting out or leading at the highest levels, this is a place to grow, stretch, and make real impact—across industries, countries, and careers.
   

  

 From engineering and product to digital services and customer experience, you’ll help connect data, devices, and people in smarter, faster ways. This is meaningful, connected work—on a global stage, with the backing of a company built for the future, and a robust benefits package designed to support your growth, well\-being, and life beyond work.
   

  

**Responsibilities :**
**Job Title**
 Network Engineer
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, they will liaise with other IT operation teams to resolve any network\-related issues. The ideal candidate must possess robust communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:**
* Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.
* Configuration and management of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
* Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.
* Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
* Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
* Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
* Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
* Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
* Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
* Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.


**Must\-have Qualifications, Skills, Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
* Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
* Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
* Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
* Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
* Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
* Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
* Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
* Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
* Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
* Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
* Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
* In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).


**Preferred Certifications:**
* Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
* CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
* Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)


**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).


**Years Of Experience In This Field**
* 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.


**How to Apply ?**
 Are you an innovator? Here is your chance to make your mark with a global technology leader. Apply now!
   

  

**Global Privacy Notice**
 Lexmark is committed to appropriately protecting and managing any personal information you share with us. Click here to view Lexmark's Privacy Notice.

title: Network Administrator
description:
The Network Administrator is responsible for the daily administration of company infrastructure systems, including hardware and software. This role involves installing, configuring, and maintaining network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and intrusion detection systems (IDS), ensuring stable and secure network operations.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Provide day\-to\-day support for network infrastructure including troubleshooting connectivity issues and resolving user\-reported problems.
* Assist in the setup, configuration, and maintenance of routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Monitor network performance and ensure reliable operation of LAN/WAN systems.
* Maintain and update network documentation and diagrams.
* Support DHCP, DNS, and IP addressing schemes (IPv4/IPv6\).
* Respond to and resolve incident tickets in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with other IT teams to support network\-related needs and changes.
* Perform basic firewall rule updates and assist with access control configurations.
* Monitor and maintain network security tools such as intrusion detection systems (IDS).
* Assist with network equipment upgrades and refresh planning.


**Desired Skills**
* Experience with Cisco networking equipment (basic configuration of switches, VLANs, trunking, NAT, and wireless access points).
* Familiarity with common networking protocols (HTTP/S, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP).
* Basic understanding of network security principles and tools (firewalls, IDS/IPS).
* Exposure to Checkpoint firewalls, F5 Load Balancers, and Zscaler cloud security solutions.
* Ability to work with terminal emulation software (e.g., PuTTY, SecureCRT).
* Understanding of the OSI model and basic network architecture concepts.
* Experience with cable patching and testing (Cat5/6, fiber).
* Exposure to Unix/Linux command line is a plus.
* Knowledge of configuration and lifecycle management practices.


**Education \& Experience**
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* 2–4 years of experience in network administration or support.
* Familiarity with Cisco IOS and basic troubleshooting methodologies.

title: Tech Content Writer - YouTube
description:
We’ve tried hiring writers who say they want to work in the YouTube space. But honestly? Many don’t have the mix of technical clarity, taste, and YouTube\-native thinking this role needs.
 



 This JD exists to help the right candidates recognize themselves.
 



  





 This is a writing role for a YouTube channel in the SaaS/tech space.
 



 If you haven’t worked with software, tools, or product\-focused content before, you might struggle in this role.
 



  





 What makes this different from a typical content writing job?
 



 Traditional writers think in paragraphs, brand guidelines, and clean grammar.
 



 But YouTube requires something else entirely — you’re writing for spoken clarity, story flow, moment\-to\-moment audience attention, and the creator’s delivery style.
 



  





 The same sentence that looks perfect on a blog can fall flat when spoken aloud. We’re looking for a writer who understands why.
 



  





**If you’re the right fit, you can naturally:** 



* Understand complex software or workflows and explain them simply
* Predict how an audience will feel at each moment in a video
* Think in scenes, not sentences
* Understand why certain channels attract certain audiences
* Read between the lines and see a creator’s intent behind the content
* Turn technical ideas into clear, engaging YouTube scripts
* Shape pacing, rhythm, and narrative flow to keep viewers watching



  





 This is not entertainment writing.
 



 This is not advertising writing.
 



 This is technical storytelling for YouTube.
 



  





**Huge bonus (almost a requirement):** 




 Experience writing for a SaaS, software, developer, engineering, or product\-focused YouTube channel.
 



  





**Not a fit if you:** 



* Come mainly from advertising, lifestyle, or entertainment writing
* Are uncomfortable understanding how software or tools work
* Prefer abstract creative writing over structured explanation
* Avoid research\-heavy content
* Have never written for spoken delivery
* Want a job where you only write but don’t think about viewer psychology
* If any of these resonate, you won’t enjoy this role — and that’s okay.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email me directly at preetham@blogvault.net with your:
 


1. Portfolio
2. LinkedIn
3. Earliest joining timeline



  





**Use the subject line:** 
 "Tech Content Writer for YouTube — \[Your Name]"
 



 (Applications through this platform won’t be reviewed.)
 



  





**Salary** 




 We’ll discuss this during our conversation — the role is dynamic, and we’re ready to invest in the right person.

**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

* Follows well\-established internal conventions and standard procedures

 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us.

 At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. At PwC, our people in people operations primarily focus on managing the people lifecycle and the day\-to\-day operational tasks related to managing employees. This includes activities such as employee onboarding, offboarding, payroll and benefits administration, absence management, employee record\-keeping, compliance with labour laws and regulations, and managing employee inquiries and issues. These individuals enable HR processes and systems to run smoothly in order to efficiently support our workforce. Those in human resource operations at PwC will focus on all areas of Human Resources and the business in executing Human Resources related transactions and administrative activities. You will be a primary HR point of contact in the resolution, escalation or routing of inquiries as needed in line with HR protocols and guidelines, as well as be part of a team of problem solvers that help solve complex business issues from strategy to execution.
   

  

 Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast\-paced environment, you are expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the Firm, you build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.
   

  

**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development.
* Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
* Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential.
* Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.
* Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback.
* Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns.
* Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness.
* Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.


 Activities to be performed:
   

  

- 

 Support L\&D programme initiatives with multiple stakeholders and work streams \- to shape and execute effective learning and leadership development solutions
   

  

* Engage any level of stakeholders in communicating the overall impact of a learning intervention to the business
* Demonstrate an understanding of PwC AC strategy, the underlying business and our client service partners,
* Support leads in managing and running our LMS (Vantage)\-based activities
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure a smooth execution, review documents on timely manner and ensure they are audit ready
* End to end execution of various programs\- technical, leadership, milestone programs etc.
* Creating/modification of training sessions, workshops and other trainings on the LMS tool\- Growth Centre
* Training logistics \- end to end logistics coordination which includes pre\-work/post work, attesting annotated agenda (if required) etc. for all training programs
* Manage logistics for marquee events and other leadership programs which includes 100\+ employees
* Invoicing\- coordinate with vendor and internal team to raise PR/SRN and ensure payment as per deadline
* Reporting\- pull reports from the tool and share with respective teams/stakeholders
* Handle queries


 Requirements These should include essential \& desirable requirements such as:
   

  

* Level of experience
* Education/qualifications
* Industry experience
* Technical capability
* Key personal attribute


 MIS/Reporting in an excel/dashboard,
   

  

* Experience working on LMS tool
* Maintaining records
* Stakeholder management (including SM \& Above)
* Communication skills
* Time management
* Vendor management
* Detail for eye Good to have:
* Knowledge in Cornerstone LMS tool,
* Good communication, excel \& Analytical skills

title: HR Reporting & PA Specialist – HR Operations
description:
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and dynamic People Analytics \& HR Reporting Specialist to join our team at a senior level. The ideal candidate will have advanced analytical and technical expertise in building dashboards and reports,
   

  

 leveraging various data sources such as EDP, data lakes, and APIs for systems like Workday. This role requires strong experience in Power BI, proficiency in Python for building predictive models, and a solid understanding of HR analytics to deliver actionable insights. Additionally, the candidate must excel in project management and stakeholder management.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design and develop advanced dashboards and visualizations using Power BI and other analytics tools. Integrate data from various sources (EDP, data lakes, APIs, Workday) for seamless reporting.
* Use Python to create predictive models for employee insights and workforce planning.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver impactful analytics solutions.
* Manage projects effectively, ensuring timely delivery of analytics initiatives.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management skills to build and maintain effective relationships.
* Support day\-to\-day standard and ad\-hoc Workday reports for stakeholders globally.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree.
* Minimum 2\+ years’ experience in Power BI, EDP, and data lake integrations.
* Proficiency in Python for advanced analytics and predictive modeling.
* Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Prior experience in core analytics is a must; HR analytics is an advantage.
* Excellent project management skills.


 Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, powering a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digital at the core. Over three billion people depend on our technologies to power their daily lives.
   

  

 With over a century in pioneering mission\-critical technologies like high\-voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing the most urgent energy challenge of our time – balancing soaring electricity demand, while decarbonizing the power system.
   

  

 Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generate revenues of around $16 billion USD. We welcome you to apply today.

title: People Operations Executive
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.
   

  

 Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Reporting to the People Director, you will create impact within our People Operations Team, within the People Capability
 *.* 
 You will be a key operational support function, ensuring the smooth processing and management of essential HR and payroll activities for the APAC \- Australia, India, Singapore, South Korea and Japan region.
   

  

 You will help align operational activities with the broader People team and agency objectives, driving efficiency and accuracy across various employee lifecycle processes.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Handle people operations for APAC \- Australia, India, Singapore, South Korea and Japan
* Responsible for all pre\-joining documentation, payroll and systems onboarding and offboarding
* Ensuring a seamless and positive employee experience at all touchpoints
* Manage administration for all elements of the employee life cycle, including preparing and collecting documents for new joiners, verifying documents, issuing contracts, leaver communication, and employment changes
* Assist with the administration for onboarding freelancers/temporary workers, ensuring appropriate checks are completed as per local legislation
* Responsible for checking and overseeing all data in the HRIS platform and managing administrative tasks and changes for the team, resolving queries and ensuring all people changes are reflected accurately in the system and on the payroll
* Work closely with payroll to support accurate payment\-related documentation is provided
* Act as the first point of contact for People Operations queries and requests, providing timely and effective support to Regional Partners, APAC payroll manager, employees and Line managers
* Provide staff reports, work with the HRIMS software to respond to people partner requests for employee data
* Ensure legal compliance for work permits, visas, and Right to Work checks, collaborating with regional partners on regulatory standards
* Continually review and refine processes for consistency and efficiency \& evaluate their effectiveness
* Complete the monthly payroll input, verifying all data is accurate and submitted before the deadline
* Manage employee benefits administration, such as medical insurance, life insurance \& pension fund schemes where applicable
* Offer support on special People Operations projects at the global and regional levels as required


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in People Operations in a UK organisation or supporting the UK region, HRIS administration, or HR shared services roles, with increasing levels of responsibility
* You have experience and understanding in UK Payroll Inputs \& System Management, Benefit Administration
* Experience with ADP WorkforceNow or a similar platform, including employee data management, benefits administration, payroll input processing, and reporting is a plus.
* Familiarity using Sage (e.g., Sage HRMS or Sage Intacct) for data reporting, accounting interface, or benefits reconciliation preferred
* Experience in generating reports, conducting audits, and performing data analysis using tools within ADP and Sage, as well as Excel (pivot tables, v\-lookup, etc.)
* Experience managing or supporting HRIS integrations with third\-party systems (e.g., ATS, payroll, finance platforms) is a plus
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* You will collaborate cross\-functionally and influence stakeholders across People, Payroll, Finance, and Legal functions


 Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.
   

  

 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.
   

  

**💫** 
 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.
   

  

 📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self\-development and access to Jellyfish Learn.
   

  

 🏦 Jellyfish contributes to your retiral benefits via Provident Fund (PF) contribution
   

  

 Jellyfish provides best in class group medical insurance \& life insurance cover to employees
   

  

*Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to* 
*talentacquisition@jellyfish.com*

title: Assistant Manager - HR Projects & Analytics
description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager \- HR Projects \& Analytics
 



  





 Role Summary:
 



 The role is responsible for driving strategic HR projects and leveraging data analytics to support evidence\-based decision\-making. The incumbent will partner with business and HR leaders to design, implement, and monitor key HR initiatives, ensuring process excellence, digital enablement, and actionable insights across the employee lifecycle.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





**HR Projects \& Transformation**



* Lead and manage end\-to\-end HR projects such as HR digital transformation, policy revamps, process automation, and organization restructuring.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify process improvement opportunities and drive efficiency through project\-based interventions.
* Develop project charters, timelines, and governance structures; track milestones and ensure timely delivery of outcomes.
* Benchmark and implement best practices in HR processes, systems, and employee experience.
* Support change management initiatives through communication, stakeholder alignment, and training programs.
* Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with internal and statutory requirements.



  





 2\.
 **HR Analytics \& Insights**



* Design and manage HR dashboards, reports, and metrics for leadership review
* Use statistical tools and data visualization techniques (Power BI / Tableau / Excel) to derive insights from HR data.
* Partner with HR COEs to define KPIs and measure program effectiveness.
* Conduct predictive analytics on workforce trends — attrition risk, hiring forecasts, and engagement patterns.
* Present insights and recommendations to leadership to support data\-driven decision\-making.



  





 3\.
 **Stakeholder \& Change Management**



* Act as a liaison between HR, business units, and external partners for project implementation.
* Facilitate workshops and discussions to gather requirements and align stakeholders on project objectives.
* Drive employee adoption of new HR tools and processes.



  





**Key Interfaces:** 




 Internal: Business HR, COEs (Talent, C\&B, L\&D), IT, Finance, Operations, Leadership Team
 



 External: HR technology vendors, consultants, and benchmarking partners
 








**Qualifications \& Experience:**



* MBA / Master’s in Human Resources, Business Analytics, or related field
* 2\-3 years of experience in HR, with strong exposure to HR projects, analytics, or HR excellence roles
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI / Tableau, and HRMS (SAP SuccessFactors / Workday / Oracle HCM preferred)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities








**Key Competencies:**



* Strategic thinking with execution focus
* Analytical mindset and data interpretation skills
* Strong collaboration and influencing capability
* Agility and openness to change
* Attention to detail and process orientation
* Project coordination and execution capability
* Collaboration and communication skills
* Process orientation and data accuracy
* Agility and openness to learn new tools

title: Human Capital - Talent Acquisition - Senior Professional/ Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

 Talent Acquisition \- Associate (Tech Recruiting)
   

  

 Gurugram, India
   

  

**Job Specification**
 KKR's Gurugram office provides best in class services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization wide process efficiency and transformation, and reflects KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 KKR’s Global Human Capital (“HC”) team provides commercially aligned people strategies by working closely with business leaders, employees, and key stakeholders to deliver on human capital and talent needs. The HC team accomplishes this by implementing world class, advisory \& talent solutions that:
   

  

* Drive first quartile investment performance
* Create differentiated outcomes aligned with the firm’s strategic priorities
* Provide an exceptional employee experience
* Preserve (and evolve) our unique culture
* Use data and analytics to inform our decision making
* Protect the firm’s license to operate


 KKR’s Human Capital team is comprised of Business Partners \& Centres of Excellence (Talent Development, Talent Acquisition, People Ops \& Data, Culture, Total Rewards, etc...). Together, they seamlessly deliver human capital services and solutions, across all stages of an employee’s lifecycle at KKR.
   

  

 The Talent Acquisition (“TA”) team within Human Capital was launched in 2020 with a small, US focused effort. Today, we are a global team of 20\+ with capabilities to recruit from campus and other early career pipelines through to senior, experienced hires across our Asset Management, Insurance and Business Operations groups. We are now focused on growing our EMEA TA platform and the team is committed to building strong partnerships across the firm, and is a tight\-knit, collaborative group that values excellence and teamwork.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 KKR is seeking a dynamic and experienced recruiter to join the firm’s growing APAC Talent Acquisition team and support our Business Operations recruiting efforts based in Gurugram. This individual will play an integral role in shaping the firm’s talent strategy by helping to identify, attract, and engage top\-tier candidates in support of KKR’s continued global growth.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a broad range of recruiting experience in the financial services or technology industry across corporate functions such as technology, finance, legal and operations with a key focus on technology hiring. They will be able to operate independently and drive full\-cycle recruiting efforts from end to end in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self\-motivated, collaborative, and resilient, with a keen eye for both strategic alignment and detail execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for technology roles across Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and Product functions along with Ops \& Finance can be added advantage.
* Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers — providing guidance on hiring strategy, market insights, and process best practices from the market.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through multiple sourcing channels (direct sourcing, referrals, market mapping, etc.).
* Evaluate, interview, and present high\-caliber candidates, ensuring thoughtful feedback loops and continuous refinement of search strategy.
* Partner closely with senior business leaders, Human Capital Business Partners to anticipate demand and proactively build talent pipelines.
* Bring forward innovative sourcing approaches and ideas to enhance efficiency and candidate quality.
* Participate actively in hiring manager discussions to stay aligned with business changes and talent priorities; act as a subject matter expert for technology recruitment.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience — maintaining timely communication, sharing feedback, and representing the firm’s values throughout the process.
* Educate candidates on the firm’s culture, growth opportunities, and value proposition.
* Lead compensation and offer discussions with both hiring managers and candidates to ensure competitive, informed, and timely closures.
* Leverage Greenhouse to its full functionality for requisition management, pipeline tracking, and data integrity.


**Qualifications**
* 6–9 years of proven experience in technology recruitment within a high\-performing corporate or search firm environment (preferably financial services, fintech, product or global tech).
* Strong understanding of technology roles, evolving skillsets, and market trends (e.g., cloud, data engineering, DevOps, AI/ML).
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience hiring across multiple disciplines and managing competing priorities with agility.
* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business needs into talent strategies.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable interacting with senior candidates and business leaders.
* Creative, results\-oriented, and adaptable to change.
* Proven ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
* Expertise in direct sourcing and in engaging passive candidates.

title: Image Analyst (QA/QC)
description:
The Image Analyst will be an important member of the Data Operations team, responsible for the Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) of GalaxEye’s Earth Observation (EO) data products. The role involves detailed inspection and validation of raw and processed SAR, MSI, and SyncFused datasets to ensure the highest radiometric, geometric, and thematic accuracy before customer delivery.
   

  




**Key Responsibilities**
**A. Quality Assurance and Control (QA/QC)**

**SAR Data:**



* Perform visual and quantitative checks to identify artifacts, calibration issues, or geometric distortions.



**MSI (Optical) Data:**



* Perform QC checks for cloud cover, haze, sensor noise, and atmospheric correction quality.
* Verify band\-to\-band registration accuracy.
* Assess orthorectification and geometric accuracy against reference data.



**SyncFused (SAR \+ MSI) Products:**



* Inspect fused outputs to ensure coherence and seamless integration of SAR and optical data.
* Identify and document artifacts introduced during the fusion process.



**Process Management:**



* Use internal software tools and automated scripts for routine QC monitoring and metric generation.
* Maintain QA/QC logs, anomaly reports, and correction status databases.


**B. Documentation \& Collaboration**
* Work closely with Data Processing Engineers and Cal/Val teams to resolve data anomalies.
* Prepare detailed quality reports summarizing issues, performance metrics, and required reprocessing.
* Contribute to improvements in QA/QC workflows and standards.


 Requirements
   

  

  

**Required Qualifications (Entry\-Level / Fresher\-Friendly)**
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, GIS, Geophysics, Electrical Engineering, or related analytical fields.
* **Core Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of EO principles, image processing basics, and coordinate systems/geodesy.
* **Software Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with GIS and remote sensing tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS, SNAP, or ENVI.
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Basic programming or scripting (Python, MATLAB) is highly desirable.
* **Mindset:** 
 Strong attention to detail, good organization, and a systematic approach to problem\-solving.


**Desired Skills (Bonus)**
* Familiarity with SAR concepts (polarization, interferometry).
* Experience in data calibration, validation, or QA\-related academic/professional work.
* Interest in learning satellite technologies and processing workflows.


 Benefits
   

  

- Competitive salary

- Health insurance

- Opportunity to work on next\-generation EO technologies

- Dynamic and collaborative work culture

- Learning and career growth opportunities

title: Procurement Engineer - Intern
description:
**About Ossus Biorenewables** 




 Ossus Biorenewables is India’s leading green hydrogen company, pioneering sustainable energy solutions through advanced bioreactor technology. With operational hydrogen plants across India, we’re accelerating the shift toward a cleaner, circular, and more energy\-efficient world.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We’re looking for a Procurement Engineer (Fresher) to join our Supply Chain \& Procurement Team — someone who’s eager to learn, highly organised, and excited to support the procurement backbone of our hydrogen and wastewater projects.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineering, project, and vendor teams to ensure timely sourcing of critical mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components that power Ossus’ technologies.
 



 If you’re detail\-oriented, enjoy coordination, and want to shape the material flow behind clean\-energy innovation, this role is a great place to start.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Prepare and float RFQs (Request for Quotations) to suppliers.
* Support the technical and commercial evaluation of vendor quotations.
* Coordinate with engineering and project teams to understand specifications, drawings, and BOQs.
* Assist in preparing purchase orders and follow up on deliveries to ensure timelines are met.
* Maintain supplier data, procurement logs, and documentation.
* Help identify and onboard new suppliers for mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components.
* Contribute to basic price analysis, comparison, and negotiation activities.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and logistics teams for inspections, dispatch, and material movement.
* Learn and support internal procurement processes using ERP or digital tools.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (0–1 year experience; freshers welcome).
* Basic understanding of engineering materials, valves, pumps, fittings, and instrumentation.
* Familiarity with procurement or supply chain processes is a plus.
* Strong documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and email drafting.
* Ability to coordinate across teams and manage multiple tasks.
* A willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a fast\-paced project environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Internship or academic project experience in procurement or supply chain.
* Exposure to vendor management or technical purchasing.
* Understanding of industrial equipment used in process or hydrogen systems.
* Experience working with ERP tools or procurement software.



  





**Why You’ll Love Working With Us** 



* **Real\-world impact:** 
 Your work directly supports the deployment of hydrogen systems across India.
* **Learning \& mentorship:** 
 Gain hands\-on exposure to procurement in high\-impact engineering projects.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** 
 Work alongside mechanical, electrical, process, QA/QC, and logistics teams.
* **Fast growth environment:** 
 Build a strong foundation to grow into Procurement Executive, Sourcing Engineer, or Project Buyer roles.
* **Purpose\-driven work:** 
 Contribute to India’s clean energy transformation and circular sustainability mission.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Network Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing company network infrastructure to ensure efficient and secure communication.
   

  

 This role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support networking needs and plays a critical role in ensuring network reliability, performance, and security.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Designs and plans network solutions, including LAN, WAN, data center, and cloud networks.
* Develops network architectures that meet the organization's current and future requirements.
* Configures, deploys, and manages network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless controllers.
* Implements and maintains network services and protocols.
* Implements and enforces network security measures, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, access controls, and VPNs.
* Diagnoses and resolves complex network issues, utilizing advanced troubleshooting techniques and network monitoring tools.
* Analyzes network performance data to identify and address bottlenecks and irregularities.
* Optimizes network performance by analyzing traffic patterns, adjusting configurations, and implementing quality of service (QoS) measures.
* Creates and maintains comprehensive network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams, including systems administrators, security teams, application developers, and business stakeholders.
* Manages/participates in network\-related projects, including network upgrades, migrations, and expansions.
* Develops project plans, define objectives, and ensure successful project execution.
* Stays updated with emerging networking technologies and industry trend.
* Works with vendors to evaluate, procure, and manage networking equipment, services, and support contracts.
* Utilizes network monitoring and analysis tools to proactively monitor network health, identify issues, and respond to incidents.
* Erforms any other related task as required.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Seasoned understanding of networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
* Seasoned proficiency in configuring and managing network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless controllers.
* Seasoned knowledge of network protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, QoS, and security protocols.
* Seasoned experience with network monitoring and analysis tools.
* Strong documentation and communication skills to convey technical information effectively.
* Seasoned proficiency in network administration and configuration tools.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
* Strong project management skills to lead and contribute to network projects.
* Seasoned familiarity with network security principles and best practices.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Network Administration certification (Azure, Google, Amazon) preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or Juniper Networks Certified Associate (JNCIA) are beneficial.
* Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE), Juniper Networks Certified Internet Expert (JNCIE), or equivalent certifications are preferred.


**Required experience:**
* Seasoned relevant experience in network engineering or a related role.
* Seasoned experience working in a networking environment.
* Seasoned experience with network security.
* Seasoned WAN and LAN experience.
* Seasoned experience in wireless equipment, protocols, standards, and wireless LAN design.
* Seasoned experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, etc.).

This role dives deep into healthcare policy and technology—you'll need to move quickly from understanding healthcare reimbursement policies to explaining how our software implements them, all while keeping content accurate and accessible.

This is an opportunity to work in a rapid delivery environment where your content reaches users quickly. If you're a writer who enjoys continuous learning in a highly collaborative space, this role offers intellectual satisfaction and meaningful impact.
 



**Why HealthEdge?** 




 The U.S. healthcare industry is a massive and essential sector, valued at $4\.4 trillion. It offers around 1\.8 million job openings in the healthcare tech industry annually. This reflects the industry's vast opportunities and the growing need for technological advancements.
 



 Specifically, the U.S. health insurance industry, where HealthEdge operates, is valued at $1\.1 trillion. This sector is known for its stability and sustainability, often remaining resilient during economic downturns and other challenging events.
 



**Impact and Scale:** 
 HealthEdge serves over 81 million lives by ensuring their health insurance claims are processed quickly and accurately. With more than 130 customers and over 100 third\-party integrations, HealthEdge tackles unique problems at an extraordinary scale daily. We support 48 out of 50 states in the U.S.
 



**Innovative Transformation:** 
 Founded in 2005, HealthEdge is transitioning from a monolithic application architecture to a modern microservices\-based architecture. This involves building new services using microservices and migrating legacy services to modern architecture, one step at a time.
 



**Unique Challenges and Opportunities:** 
 Working at HealthEdge offers a unique opportunity to gain unmatched experience. Migrating such a large\-scale product with hundreds of customers and processing millions of transactions daily presents challenges that are rare in the industry.
 



 At HealthEdge, you'll be part of an exciting journey to revolutionize the health insurance industry through innovative technology solutions. We hope you're as excited as we are to take on this challenge and make a significant impact in the healthcare sector.
 



**What you will do:** 



* Translate complex healthcare policies and software functionality into accurate and user\-friendly release notes, guides, UI copy, and reference materials.

* Research and verify information against healthcare and technical resources to ensure documentation accuracy and build deep domain expertise.
* Collaborate with developers, analysts, and subject matter experts throughout the documentation lifecycle, from requirements refinement through final reviews.

**What you bring:**

* Collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills—you build trust and work effectively with diverse stakeholder groups across different time zones
* Strong critical analysis skills and enthusiasm to learn—you enjoy researching, synthesizing complex and/or technical information, and translating topics into clear and concise written communication

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
At Leapwork, our vision is to break down the barriers between humans and computers through the worlds most accessible automation platform. We are the leading global AI\-powered visual test automation solution, enabling some of the worlds largest enterprises to adopt, scale, and maintain automation in under 30 days.
   

  

 In todays environment, where efficiency, automation, and cost optimization are essential to enterprise growth, we are uniquely positioned to deliver impact.
   

  

 In 2023, Microsoft, the worlds largest and most recognizable software company, recognised Leapwork as a truly innovative and disruptive product, leading to a strategic partnership that continues to be a major growth catalyst.
   

  

**Product Enablement** 
 at Leapwork is the technical and documentation voice of the company, ensuring our products are understood clearly, both inside and outside Leapwork.
   

  

 Our mission is to make complex information simple, accurate, and accessible. We help internal teams stay informed about new releases and product changes, while creating the external knowledge that empowers users to learn, adopt, and succeed with Leapwork.
   

  

 We anticipate the questions our users and colleagues might have, building the foundation of knowledge that supports every release, every feature, and every interaction.
   

  

 Product Enablement helps users experience the magic of Leapwork. We translate technical innovation into clarity and excitement that drive product adoption and expansion, ensuring users realize value faster and become champions of Leapwork.
   

  

 Core values: adaptability, audience awareness, clarity, and ownership.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Senior Technical Writer** 
 within Product Enablement, you will ensure that every Leapwork release is clearly explained, accurately documented, and fully understood, both internally and externally.
   

  

 Your work will focus on helping teams and customers understand new features and product improvements. You will facilitate understanding of product updates through external documentation, release notes, and complementary materials that make complex concepts simple and accessible.
   

  

 You will create engaging, audience\-focused content that supports the comprehension and adoption of the product. From product documentation and release notes to visual explainers, your work will help others grasp how Leapwork evolves.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with teams, including Product, Design, Marketing, and Customer Success, to ensure that all product information is communicated accurately and consistently.
   

  

 We are looking for someone proactive, curious, and adaptable, with strong technical understanding and attention to detail.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Create and maintain clear, accurate, and accessible documentation for product features, updates, and releases.
* Write and edit release notes with an audience\-focused narrative that highlights the most impactful product changes.
* Support visual communication, helping transform complex updates into diagrams, infographics, or short videos.
* Ensure consistency, clarity, and tone across all documentation and release communications.
* Anticipate information needs for upcoming releases and stay informed about product development cycles.
* Collaborate with Product Enablement peers to improve documentation structure and accessibility for users.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to align messaging and accuracy.
* Meet deadlines effectively and maintain high\-quality standards in all deliverables.


**Core Skills**
* High or business\-level English proficiency, both written and spoken.
* Proven experience in technical writing, with the ability to quickly adapt to new domains and complex systems. Experience in the software industry is a plus.
* Strong ability to apply visual thinking and storytelling in documentation.
* Familiarity with APIs, digital platforms, or technical processes is a plus.
* Experience using content management and collaboration tools.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and organizational skills.
* Understanding of Agile workflows and product development cycles.
* Experience leveraging AI tools or agentic systems to streamline content creation, improve productivity, or enhance content quality is a strong advantage.
* Adaptable, self\-directed, and reliable, able to meet deadlines and deliver consistent, high\-quality work.
* Collaborative team players who value transparency, respect, and open communication.


**Preferred Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in technical, scientific, or analytical fields, such as Engineering, Information Science, or a related discipline, or proven experience understanding and explaining complex systems.
* Experience creating user\-centered and visually engaging documentation that combines technical accuracy with clear structure and strong visual presentation.
* Strong technical curiosity and growth\-oriented mindset, combining analytical thinking with creativity to make complex ideas clearer, more engaging, and easier to understand.


**Why Leapwork?**
 We are on an exciting journey of global growth – and this is your chance to get onboard and an opportunity to lead and shape digital transformation initiatives in a forward\-thinking company, working with and learning from a talented and passionate team committed to innovation and excellence
   

  

 By joining our team, you’ll become part of a fast\-paced international environment where you can grow, challenge yourself, and do what inspires you. We work hard, but have fun while doing it – and we believe that collaboration, social activities and celebration are keys to success.
   

  

**Our Leapwork Principles**
 Our five key principles capture the essence of what it means to be a part of our world\-class team! They are integral to how we approach our work and one another, and they serve as a roadmap to our continued growth, development, achievements, and success.
   

  

**Customer first;** 
 We listen to our customers, understand their pain points and focus on what matters to them.
   

  

**Lead from the front;** 
 Leading means guiding others towards the solutions to our challenges.
   

  

**Get it done;** 
 We make commitments, follow through and deliver work we’re proud of.
   

  

**Build excellence;** 
 We do our best work every day, holding ourselves and others to the highest standards.
   

  

**Respectfully different;** 
 We treat each other with respect, always. We’re different, not indifferent.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Technical Writer – AWS Competency \& Cloud Documentation
 



  





 About Marketeering
 



  





 Marketeering is a specialist marketing and GTM partner for cloud companies.
 



 We help AWS and Azure partners get listed, found, and funded through marketplace listings, competencies, service validations, and campaign execution.
 



  





 We’re now building a small core team that deeply understands both technical documentation and AWS programs.
 



  





  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We’re looking for a Technical Writer who lives at the intersection of cloud, DevOps/architecture and clear, structured documentation.
 



  





 Your primary responsibility will be to create, refine, and review documents required for AWS programs – especially Competencies, Service Delivery/Service Ready, and other AWS validations. You will work closely with our founder, solution architects, and client teams to turn complex implementations into crisp, audit\-ready documentation that matches AWS standards.
 



  





 If you enjoy turning messy technical inputs into clean, evidence\-backed documents, this role is for you.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Own AWS Documentation Workstreams
 



 • Draft, edit, and standardize documents required for:
 



 • AWS Competencies
 



 • Service Delivery / Service Ready validations
 



 • FTR (Foundational Technical Review) support docs
 



 • Case studies, implementation write\-ups, architecture narratives, and SOPs.
 



 • Create Clear, Structured Technical Docs
 



 • Convert raw inputs (call notes, architecture diagrams, Jira tickets, emails) into:
 



 • Customer case studies aligned to AWS templates
 



 • Detailed implementation descriptions
 



 • Architecture overviews and solution blueprints
 



 • Runbooks / process docs where needed.
 



 • Align with AWS Guidelines
 



 • Review AWS documentation requirements and checklists.
 



 • Ensure every submission meets AWS format, depth, and evidence expectations.
 



 • Document Review \& Quality Control
 



 • Review documents prepared by other team members or client teams.
 



 • Check for:
 



 • Technical accuracy
 



 • Clarity and structure
 



 • Consistency of terminology
 



 • Alignment with AWS wording and positioning.
 



 • Collaboration \& Research
 



 • Work directly with founders, PMs, architects, and client engineering teams.
 



 • Ask the right questions to fill gaps in technical stories and evidence.
 



 • Research AWS services, reference architectures, and best practices when needed.
 



 • Template \& Process Building
 



 • Help us build reusable templates for competencies, case studies, and validations.
 



 • Contribute to internal documentation standards and style guides.
 



  





  





 Must\-Have Skills \& Experience
 



 • 2–5 years of experience in technical writing for software / cloud / SaaS companies.
 



 • Strong understanding of at least one of these areas:
 



 • AWS / cloud infrastructure
 



 • DevOps / CI/CD
 



 • Application modernization / microservices / containerization
 



 • Prior experience writing any of the following:
 



 • Technical implementation documents
 



 • Architecture / design documents
 



 • Product / platform documentation
 



 • Customer case studies or solution briefs with technical depth.
 



 • Ability to:
 



 • Read and interpret architecture diagrams (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, etc.)
 



 • Interview engineers / architects and convert conversations into structured documentation
 



 • Write in clear, concise, and neutral language suitable for audits and program reviews.
 



 • Strong command of written English – structure, flow, formatting, and attention to detail.
 



 • Comfortable working remotely, managing your own deadlines, and handling multiple projects.
 



  





  





 Good\-to\-Have (Bonus)
 



 • Hands\-on experience with AWS (certifications, real projects, or strong self\-learning).
 



 • Prior exposure to AWS Partner Network (APN), Competencies, Service Delivery, or FTR documentation.
 



 • Experience working with global SaaS / cloud companies.
 



 • Familiarity with tools like Confluence, Notion, Jira, Google Docs, Lucidchart / Draw.io, etc.
 



  





  





 What You’ll Get
 



 • Opportunity to work at the core of AWS GTM \& Competency projects for multiple cloud clients.
 



 • Direct exposure to AWS partner programs, marketplace GTM, and real customer architectures.
 



 • Close collaboration with founders (not a big, slow org).
 



 • Freedom to improve templates, processes, and documentation standards from day one.
 



  





  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Please share:
 



 • Your CV
 



 • 2–3 technical writing samples (preferably architecture docs, case studies, or implementation guides)
 



 • A brief note (3–5 lines) on your experience with AWS / cloud

title: Backend Software Development Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team:** 




 Cisco Spaces is the intelligence layer that turns buildings into dynamic, data\-driven environments. By connecting to Cisco’s global network of access points, sensors and cameras, Spaces delivers real\-time insights and automation that help organizations run safer, smarter and more sustainable workplaces.
 



 Today, Spaces is one of Cisco’s fastest\-growing platforms with more than twelve billion square feet of real estate digitized worldwide. As Cisco moves deeper into a software\-first future, Spaces sits at the center of cloud, IoT, maps, analytics and AI.
 



 The platform brings together everything needed for a modern hybrid workplace. It provides live occupancy and utilization insights, indoor maps, bookings, visitor flows, environmental and air\-quality data, people and asset visibility, and automated workflows that make operations more efficient. Customers manage entire portfolios of buildings, connect third\-party solutions through our partner ecosystem, and use our APIs to build new use cases on top of the platform.
 



 Spaces is where large\-scale cloud engineering, real\-time data, AI and enterprise UX meet. We are a team that ships fast, innovates continuously and builds technology that genuinely changes how buildings function.
 



  





**Your Impact:** 




 As a Backend Software Engineer on the Cisco Spaces team, you will shape the core systems that power one of Cisco’s fastest\-growing platforms. You will build the high\-scale services that process billions of events, enable real\-time building intelligence, and deliver reliable services to customers across the world.
 



 • Design, implement, and deploy backend services that handle massive scale, high concurrency, and global reliability requirements.
 



 • Build end\-to\-end systems in Java that prioritize performance, stability, and clean architecture.
 



 • Develop APIs and microservices that power real\-time occupancy, mapping, automation, IoT integrations, and analytics across thousands of enterprise sites.
 



 • Work closely with frontend, product and platform teams to ensure seamless delivery of features that span cloud, IoT, mapping and AI layers.
 



 • Optimize data pipelines, storage models, and streaming systems to support live telemetry from millions of connected devices.
 



 • Introduce new technologies, frameworks, and design patterns that raise the engineering bar across the team.
 



 • Contribute to platform\-wide initiatives such as improving scalability, strengthening security, enhancing observability, and refining deployment and CI/CD practices.
 



 • Learn and apply emerging AI and automation techniques where they materially improve system intelligence, accuracy, or developer efficiency.
 



 • Own features from concept to rollout and ensure they meet the quality, reliability, and performance expected from Cisco\-grade systems
 



  





**Minimum Qualification:** 




 •Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science.
 



 • A minimum of two years of hands\-on experience building backend systems, web applications, and integrations in production environments.
 



 • Strong server\-side development expertise in Java, with experience in J2EE, Vert.x, or Kotlin\-based services.
 



 • Deep understanding of core Java fundamentals including threading, concurrency, synchronization, collections, generics, annotations, and JVM internals.
 



 • Familiarity with inter\-thread communication patterns, serialization mechanisms, and performance tuning of high\-throughput services.
 



 • Strong grasp of object\-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns.
 



 • Practical experience building scalable REST APIs, backend services, and microservice architectures.
 



 • Working knowledge of NoSQL databases and distributed data models.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Kafka or similar streaming platforms, including message modeling, high\-volume consumers, producers, and streaming pipelines.
 



 • Exposure to building and operating services in large\-scale cloud environments such as AWS, and comfort working with cloud\-native services.
 



 • Proficiency with Maven or Gradle, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and related engineering tooling.
 



 • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including service discovery, fault tolerance, and event\-driven architectures.
 



 • Ability to work in fast\-paced agile teams and drive technical decisions in complex development environments.
 



 • Comfort using modern AI development tools and assistants to enhance productivity, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
 



 • Ability to rapidly learn new frameworks, libraries, and technologies as required.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 •Experience designing and operating microservices at scale using Java, Vert.x, or Kotlin in high\-throughput, low\-latency environments.
 



 • Hands\-on experience running workloads on AWS, including EKS, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, Lambda or similar managed services.
 



 • Strong familiarity with modern container and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh patterns.
 



 • Practical experience building streaming or event\-driven architectures using Kafka, including partitions, consumer groups, offset handling, back\-pressure strategies, and exactly\-once semantics.
 



 • Comfort troubleshooting distributed systems: debugging timeouts, thread starvation, queue backlogs, serialization bottlenecks, and GC/JVM performance issues.
 



 • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing pipelines, canary deployments, observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK), and production monitoring best practices.
 



 • Ability to analyze complex systems, decompose problems, reason about edge cases, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between performance, reliability, and simplicity.
 



 • Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools for rapid prototyping, code generation, unit test creation, architecture exploration, and productivity amplification.
 



 • Experience driving process improvements, standardizing patterns, automating repetitive workflows, and influencing engineering best practices across teams.
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret metrics, logs, and behavioral trends to improve system performance and operational efficiency.
 



 • Exposure to building secure, compliant, and resilient cloud\-native systems with proper handling of authentication, authorization, encryption, and data privacy requirements.
 



 • Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, handle ambiguity, and contribute effectively in cross\-functional teams involving backend, frontend, product, and platform engineering.
 



 • Passion for continuous learning and staying updated with new frameworks, cloud capabilities, architectural approaches, and emerging technologies.
 



  





 Why Cisco?
 



 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. **Company Details** 




  





 Crux was founded in 2017 to address the challenges organizations face when bringing in external data from disparate sources for analytics, data science, and business intelligence. The company has built a platform that automates key parts of the external data workflow: integrating third\-party datasets, transforming them into useful formats, ensuring continuous data quality, and managing operational aspects like supplier contracts, data delivery, and observability.
 



 Many businesses depend increasingly on external data (market data, alternative data, etc.), but integrating that data reliably and tracking issues (data delays, format changes, missing values, etc.) is hard. Crux works as the bridge between data suppliers and consumers, helping to reduce manual work and risk. Its infrastructure is cloud\-oriented and built for scale, supporting observability (so teams see when data is stale or wrong), transformation (cleaning, reshaping), and making data science\-ready inputs.
 



  





 The company has raised venture funding (Series B) to accelerate its product development, expand its team, and deepen its capabilities. Investors include large financial \& analytics\-oriented firms. Crux is used by organizations that need trustworthy external data pipelines so they can focus more on insights than fixing data issues.
